rules.outcome: OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE holds the reformatted date (expected YYYYMMDD per the 88-level meanings).
rules.statement: The account reissue date is reformatted for the extract by calling COBDATFT with input type '2' (YYYY-MM-DD-IN) and output type '2' (YYYYMMDD-OP); the converted CODATECN-0UT-DATE becomes OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE.

rules.outcome: Abend code 999; no further records processed.
rules.statement: Any account-file read status other than '00' (record) or '10' (end of file) stops the job: the program displays 'ERROR READING ACCOUNT FILE', the file status, and abends with code 999 via CEE3ABD.

rules.outcome: 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT for the previous account (if WS-FIRST-TIME is not 'Y'); WS-TOTAL-INT = 0; 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA and 1110-GET-XREF-DATA for the new account.
rules.statement: Transaction-category balances are processed as a control break on account id: when TRANCAT-ACCT-ID changes, the previously accumulated interest is posted to the previous account (not on the first record), the interest total is reset to zero, and the new account record and its card cross-reference are read.

rules.outcome: 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST and 1400-COMPUTE-FEES are performed.
rules.statement: Interest (and the future fee calculation) is generated for a transaction category only when the disclosure-group interest rate DIS-INT-RATE for the account group, transaction type and category is non-zero; zero-rate categories produce no interest transaction.

rules.outcome: Re-read DISCGRP with FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID = 'DEFAULT'; abend 999 with 'ERROR READING DEFAULT DISCLOSURE GROUP' if not found.
rules.statement: When no disclosure group record exists for the account's group id, type and category (status '23'), the interest rate is taken from the disclosure group with group id 'DEFAULT' for the same type and category; if that default record is also missing the job abends.

rules.outcome: ACCT-CURR-BAL += WS-TOTAL-INT; ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT = 0; ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT = 0; REWRITE of the account record.
rules.statement: Monthly interest of all categories of an account is summed in WS-TOTAL-INT; at the account break the total is added to the account's current balance and the current-cycle credit and debit totals are reset to zero before the account is rewritten.

rules.outcome: One TRAN-RECORD written to TRANSACT per interest-bearing category.
rules.statement: Each computed monthly interest amount is posted as a system transaction: id = run date parameter (PARM-DATE) + 6-digit running sequence, type '01', category 5, source 'System', description 'Int. for a/c ' followed by the account id, amount = monthly interest, card number from the account's cross-reference, and the current timestamp as both origin and processing timestamp.

rules.conditions: ACCTFILE-STATUS or XREFFILE-STATUS not '00' after the keyed read.
rules.outcome: 'ERROR READING ACCOUNT FILE' / 'ERROR READING XREF FILE', file status display, abend 999.
rules.statement: A transaction-category balance whose account is missing from the account master (or has no card cross-reference) is not skipped: the program displays 'ACCOUNT NOT FOUND: ' with the id and abends the run with code 999.

rules.outcome: EXPFILE contains all records of the five source files.
rules.statement: The branch-migration export is a full, unfiltered extract: every customer, account, card cross-reference, transaction and card record is exported, in that fixed order (one entity type after another), with no selection criteria.

rules.outcome: EXPORT-REC-TYPE, EXPORT-TIMESTAMP, EXPORT-SEQUENCE-NUM, EXPORT-BRANCH-ID, EXPORT-REGION-CODE populated.
rules.statement: Each export record carries a type code identifying the entity ('C' customer, 'A' account, 'X' card cross-reference, 'T' transaction, 'D' card), the run timestamp, a sequence number incremented across all record types, branch id '0001' and region code 'NORTH'.

rules.conditions: Open status not '00'; read status not '00' and not '10'.
rules.outcome: Abend; partial export file may remain.
rules.statement: Any failure to open a source or export file, or any read status other than success/end-of-file, stops the export with an error message naming the file and its status and an abend via CEE3ABD.

rules.outcome: Abend via 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
rules.statement: A failed write of any export record (status not '00') aborts the whole export run; no record is skipped silently.

rules.outcome: Record written to CUSTOUT, ACCTOUT, XREFOUT, TRNXOUT or CARDOUT, or handled by 2700-PROCESS-UNKNOWN-RECORD.
rules.statement: Each export record is routed to its normalized target file by EXPORT-REC-TYPE: 'C' to the customer file, 'A' to the account file, 'X' to the card cross-reference file, 'T' to the transaction file, 'D' to the card file; any other type is treated as an unknown record.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Unknown record type encountered' TO ERR-MESSAGE
rules.outcome: Error record written to ERROUT; WS-UNKNOWN-RECORD-TYPE-COUNT and WS-ERROR-RECORDS-WRITTEN incremented.
rules.statement: A record with an unknown type is not imported and does not stop the run: it is counted, logged to the error file with timestamp, type, sequence number and 'Unknown record type encountered', and processing continues.

rules.conditions: Open status not '00'; read status not '00'/'10'; write status not '00'.
rules.outcome: Abend; target files may be partially written.
rules.statement: Failure to open any file, a read error on the export file (status not '00'/'10'), or a failed write to any target master file aborts the import via CEE3ABD.

rules.outcome: One record written to the matching target file.
rules.statement: Imported records are rebuilt field by field into the standard CardDemo master layouts (customer 500, account 300, cross-reference 50, transaction 350, card 150 bytes), converting the export's packed (COMP/COMP-3) numeric fields back to the display formats of CVCUS01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y and CVACT02Y. No field is validated or altered.

rules.outcome: QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE set; MAIN-PARA then deletes the PAUTDTL1 segment (5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL). Otherwise NOT-QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE and the detail is kept.
rules.statement: A pending authorization detail is selected for purge when the number of days between today (YYDDD) and its authorization date (99999 minus the stored complemented PA-AUTH-DATE-9C) is greater than or equal to the expiry-days threshold.

rules.conditions: Detail qualified for delete; split on PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE = '00'
rules.outcome: Summary counters in PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY are reduced in working storage (no REPL of the summary segment is issued in this program).
rules.statement: When an expired detail is purged, its effect is backed out of the summary totals: an approved detail (PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE '00') decrements PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT and reduces PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT by PA-APPROVED-AMT; any other response code decrements PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT and reduces PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT by PA-TRANSACTION-AMT.

rules.outcome: 6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY performs DLET of the PAUTSUM0 segment (IMS deletes any remaining child details with it).
rules.statement: After all details of an account summary have been processed, the pending authorization summary root is deleted when its approved authorization count is zero or negative. The condition tests PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT twice; the declined count is not tested.

rules.conditions: SYSIN PRM-INFO fields absent or invalid
rules.outcome: WS-EXPIRY-DAYS = 5, P-CHKP-FREQ = 5, P-CHKP-DIS-FREQ = 10, P-DEBUG-FLAG = 'N' as applicable.
rules.statement: Run parameters default when missing: expiry days default to 5 when the SYSIN value is not numeric; checkpoint frequency defaults to 5 and checkpoint display frequency to 10 when blank, zero or low-values; the debug flag is forced to 'N' unless it is 'Y'.

rules.outcome: 9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT issues DLI CHKP and WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT is reset to 0.
rules.statement: An IMS checkpoint is taken after more than P-CHKP-FREQ summaries have been processed since the last checkpoint, and again at the end of the run, so the purge is committed in units of work.

rules.conditions: Unexpected DIBSTAT after GN, GNP, DLET or CHKP
rules.outcome: Display 'CBPAUP0C ABENDING ...', RETURN-CODE 16, GOBACK.
rules.statement: Any DL/I status other than the expected ones (spaces; 'GB' end of database on summary read; 'GE'/'GB' on detail read) on read, delete or checkpoint stops the purge with return code 16 after displaying the status and counters.

rules.conditions: TRNX-CARD-NUM equal to / different from WS-SAVE-CARD.
rules.outcome: WS-CARD-NUM, WS-TRAN-NUM, WS-TRAN-REST and WS-TRCT populated; CR-CNT = number of cards.
rules.statement: Before any statement is produced, all transactions are loaded into a two-dimensional in-memory table grouped by card number: consecutive transactions with the same TRNX-CARD-NUM are stored under one card entry, and a change of card number starts a new card entry. The table holds up to 51 cards with up to 10 transactions each.

rules.conditions: WS-CARD-NUM(CR-JMP) = XREF-CARD-NUM; search ends when CR-JMP > CR-CNT or WS-CARD-NUM(CR-JMP) > XREF-CARD-NUM.
rules.outcome: Each matching transaction written as a detail line (text and HTML).
rules.statement: A statement lists only the transactions whose card number equals the cross-reference card number being processed. The table search stops at the first table card number greater than the cross-reference card, which assumes both files are in ascending card-number order (TRNXFILE is keyed by card number + transaction id in CBSTM03B).

rules.outcome: ST-TOTAL-TRAMT printed on ST-LINE14A.
rules.statement: The statement total ('Total EXP:') is the sum of TRNX-AMT of all transactions listed for the card; it is reset to zero for each cross-reference record.

rules.conditions: WS-M03B-RC not '00' after customer or account keyed read; not '00'/'10' after cross-reference read.
rules.outcome: 'ERROR READING CUSTFILE' / 'ERROR READING ACCTFILE' / 'ERROR READING XREFFILE', return code display, abend via CEE3ABD.
rules.statement: Every card cross-reference must resolve to an existing customer (XREF-CUST-ID) and account (XREF-ACCT-ID); if either keyed read fails, or the cross-reference read fails other than end of file, the statement run abends instead of skipping the card.

rules.outcome: ST-NAME, ST-ADD1..3, ST-ACCT-ID, ST-CURR-BAL, ST-FICO-SCORE in text and HTML output.
rules.statement: The statement header shows the customer name as first, middle and last name each truncated at the first space and separated by single spaces, address lines 1 and 2, a third address line combining address line 3, state, country and ZIP, plus account id, current balance and FICO score.

rules.conditions: Each XREFFILE record read with RC '00'.
rules.outcome: Statement header, transaction lines and total written to STMTFILE and HTMLFILE.
rules.statement: One statement (text and HTML) is produced for every record in the card cross-reference file, in cross-reference order, until end of file.

rules.anchor: ' COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. SKIPPING TRANSACTION ID-'
rules.conditions: DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM not found in XREFFILE (INVALID KEY, WS-XREF-READ-STATUS = 4).
messages: COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. SKIPPING TRANSACTION ID-
rules.outcome: DISPLAY 'CARD NUMBER <n> COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. SKIPPING TRANSACTION ID-<id>'; no account lookup.
rules.statement: A daily transaction is accepted for further checking only if its card number exists in the card cross-reference file; otherwise the transaction is reported as unverifiable and skipped.

rules.conditions: WS-XREF-READ-STATUS = 0 and account read INVALID KEY (WS-ACCT-READ-STATUS = 4).
rules.outcome: DISPLAY 'INVALID ACCOUNT NUMBER FOUND' and 'ACCOUNT <id> NOT FOUND'.
rules.statement: For a transaction whose card is in the cross-reference, the linked account (XREF-ACCT-ID) must exist in the account master; if not, the program reports 'ACCOUNT <id> NOT FOUND'. No further action (posting or rejection file) follows either way.

rules.outcome: File status displayed; CEE3ABD abend code 999.
rules.statement: A read error on the daily transaction file (status other than '00' or '10') aborts the run with abend code 999, while card or account lookup failures only skip/report the transaction.

rules.conditions: No XREF-FILE record keyed by DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM (INVALID KEY).
rules.outcome: WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 100, description 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'; the transaction is later written to DALYREJS.
rules.statement: Each daily transaction's card number (DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM) must exist in the card cross-reference file; otherwise the transaction is rejected with reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'.

rules.outcome: 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT is performed; otherwise the reason 100 stands.
rules.statement: Account-level validation (account existence, credit limit, expiration) is only performed when the card cross-reference lookup succeeded.

rules.conditions: No ACCOUNT-FILE record keyed by XREF-ACCT-ID (INVALID KEY).
rules.outcome: WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 101, description 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'.
rules.statement: The account referenced by the card cross-reference (XREF-ACCT-ID) must exist in the account master; otherwise the transaction is rejected with reason 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'.

rules.outcome: WS-TEMP-BAL holds the projected balance compared against the credit limit.
rules.statement: The projected cycle balance used for the credit-limit check is WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT (the account's current balance ACCT-CURR-BAL is not used).

rules.outcome: WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 102, description 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' (may be overwritten by reason 103).
rules.statement: A transaction is rejected as over-limit (reason 102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION') when the account credit limit is less than the projected cycle balance WS-TEMP-BAL; a projected balance equal to the limit is allowed.

rules.conditions: ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE < DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS(1:10), compared as character strings.
rules.outcome: WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 103, description 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'.
rules.statement: A transaction whose origination date (first 10 characters of DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS) is later than the account expiration date ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE is rejected with reason 103 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'; a transaction on the expiration date itself is accepted. This check runs even if the over-limit check already failed and then overrides reason 102.

rules.outcome: Posted via 2000-POST-TRANSACTION; otherwise WS-REJECT-COUNT + 1 and 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC.
rules.statement: A daily transaction that passes all validations (reason code 0) is posted; any non-zero reason code causes the transaction to be counted as rejected and written to the daily rejects file instead of being posted.

rules.outcome: One REJECT-RECORD written to DALYREJS (LRECL 430).
rules.statement: A rejected transaction is written to DALYREJS as the full 350-byte input record followed by an 80-byte validation trailer containing the 4-digit reason code and its 76-character description.

rules.outcome: RETURN-CODE = 4.
rules.statement: When at least one transaction was rejected, the job step ends with return code 4 (warning) instead of 0.

rules.outcome: TRAN-RECORD populated and later written to TRANSACT-FILE.
rules.statement: A posted transaction record copies all business fields from the daily transaction record and stamps TRAN-PROC-TS with the current system timestamp in DB2 format (the input DALYTRAN-PROC-TS is not used).

rules.conditions: TCATBAL READ by key (XREF-ACCT-ID, DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD, DALYTRAN-CAT-CD) returned INVALID KEY.
messages: TCATBAL record not found for key :
rules.outcome: 2700-A-CREATE-TCATBAL-REC when not found, else 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC.
rules.statement: Category balances are kept per account + transaction type + transaction category. If no balance record exists for that key, a new one is created; otherwise the existing record is updated.

rules.conditions: No existing balance record for the key.
rules.outcome: New TCATBAL record written with TRAN-CAT-BAL = DALYTRAN-AMT.
rules.statement: A newly created category balance record starts at zero and is set to the transaction amount.

rules.conditions: Balance record exists for the key.
rules.outcome: TRAN-CAT-BAL = TRAN-CAT-BAL + DALYTRAN-AMT; REWRITE.
rules.statement: For an existing category balance record, the transaction amount (signed) is added to TRAN-CAT-BAL and the record is rewritten.

rules.anchor: IF DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
rules.conditions: Transaction is being posted; split on DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0.
rules.outcome: ACCT-CURR-BAL and either ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT or ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT updated; account record rewritten.
rules.statement: Posting adds the signed transaction amount to the account current balance ACCT-CURR-BAL; non-negative amounts are also accumulated in ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and negative amounts in ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT (as negative values).

rules.outcome: WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 109 set; processing continues with 2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE.
rules.statement: If the account rewrite fails with INVALID KEY, reason 109 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' is set but has no effect: the transaction is still written to the transaction master and is not rejected.

rules.outcome: Abend via 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.
rules.statement: When reading the category balance file, status '00' (found) and '23' (not found) are both normal; any other status stops the run with 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION BALANCE FILE' and an abend.

rules.conditions: A paragraph detects a non-'00' file status (or non-'00'/'10' on read).
rules.outcome: Abend U999 after displaying 'ABENDING PROGRAM'.
rules.statement: Any fatal file error (open, read, write, rewrite or close failure that the program tests) terminates the job step with user abend code 999 through the Language Environment service CEE3ABD.

rules.anchor: IF TRAN-PROC-TS (1:10) >= WS-START-DATE AND TRAN-PROC-TS (1:10) <= WS-END-DATE
rules.outcome: In range: record is processed. Out of range: NEXT SENTENCE.
rules.statement: Only transactions whose processing date (first 10 characters of TRAN-PROC-TS) is between the DATEPARM start date and end date, both inclusive, are reported. The comparison is a character comparison. An out-of-range record executes NEXT SENTENCE, which (Inferred) leaves the read loop rather than skipping just that record.

rules.conditions: WS-CURR-CARD-NUM differs from TRAN-CARD-NUM; account totals only when WS-FIRST-TIME = 'N'.
rules.outcome: 1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS, WS-CURR-CARD-NUM updated, 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF performed.
rules.statement: When the card number changes from the previous transaction, the accumulated 'Account Total' of the previous card is printed (not before the first detail line) and the card cross-reference is read to obtain the account id for the new card. Correct grouping relies on the input being sorted by card number (done by the SORT step in TRANREPT.jcl).

rules.outcome: Display 'INVALID CARD NUMBER : ', file status 0023, abend 999.
rules.statement: A reported transaction whose card number is not in the card cross-reference file stops the report run with an abend.

rules.outcome: Display 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE : ', file status 0023, abend 999.
rules.statement: A reported transaction whose type code is not in the transaction type file stops the report run with an abend.

rules.outcome: Display 'INVALID TRAN CATG KEY : ', file status 0023, abend 999.
rules.statement: A reported transaction whose type + category combination is not in the transaction category file stops the report run with an abend.

rules.outcome: WS-FIRST-TIME set to 'N'; headers written.
rules.statement: Before the first detail line the report header is written once with the DATEPARM start and end dates as the report date range.

rules.outcome: 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS and 1120-WRITE-HEADERS.
rules.statement: A page break (page total line followed by new headers) occurs before a detail line whenever the running line count is an exact multiple of the page size of 20 lines.

rules.outcome: WS-PAGE-TOTAL and WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL increased by TRAN-AMT.
rules.statement: Each reported transaction amount is added to both the current page total and the current account (card) total.

rules.outcome: WS-GRAND-TOTAL += WS-PAGE-TOTAL; WS-PAGE-TOTAL = 0.
rules.statement: The grand total is the sum of the page totals: when a page total is printed it is added to WS-GRAND-TOTAL and the page total is reset to zero.

rules.outcome: 'Account Total' line written; WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL = 0.
rules.statement: When an account (card) total is printed, WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL is reset to zero for the next card.

rules.outcome: 1110-WRITE-PAGE-TOTALS and 1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS.
rules.statement: At end of the transaction file the program adds TRAN-AMT (still holding the last record read) to the page and account totals, then prints the final page total and the grand total; no final account total is printed.

rules.outcome: '00': display range; '10': END-OF-FILE = 'Y'; other: 'ERROR READING DATEPARM FILE' and abend.
rules.statement: The report date range comes from the first DATEPARM record; if DATEPARM is empty the run ends without reading transactions or writing a report line, and any other read error abends.

rules.outcome: TRANSACTION-DETAIL-REPORT written to TRANREPT.
rules.statement: Each detail line shows transaction id, account id (from the card xref), type code and description, category code and description, source and amount; descriptions are truncated to the report column widths (15 and 29 characters).

rules.conditions: Open/read/write/close status not as expected, or a lookup INVALID KEY.
rules.outcome: Abend U999 after 'ABENDING PROGRAM'.
rules.statement: Any fatal file error tested by the program terminates the step with user abend code 999 via CEE3ABD.

rules.outcome: Rejection text reply put on the reply queue; request is consumed.
rules.statement: An account inquiry request is accepted only when the 4-character function code WS-FUNC equals 'INQA' and the 11-digit account number WS-KEY is greater than zero. Otherwise no file read happens and the reply is 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID : ' followed by WS-KEY and 'FUNCTION : ' followed by WS-FUNC.

rules.conditions: CICS READ of ACCTDAT by WS-KEY returns NORMAL
rules.outcome: Formatted account reply put on CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT
rules.statement: When the account is found in ACCTDAT, the reply is the fixed-layout text record WS-ACCT-RESPONSE: labels 'ACCOUNT ID : ', 'ACCOUNT STATUS : ', 'BALANCE : ', 'CREDIT LIMIT : ', 'CASH LIMIT : ', 'OPEN DATE : ', 'EXPR DATE : ', 'REIS DATE : ', 'CREDIT BAL : ', 'DEBIT BAL : ', 'GROUP ID : ' each followed by the matching ACCOUNT-RECORD field. ACCT-ADDR-ZIP is not returned.

rules.outcome: Not-found text reply put on the reply queue
rules.statement: If the requested account number is not on ACCTDAT (NOTFND), the requester receives the reply 'INVALID REQUEST PARAMETERS ACCT ID : ' followed by WS-KEY; processing continues with the next message.

rules.conditions: WS-RESP-CD other than NORMAL or NOTFND
rules.outcome: Error message on CARD.DEMO.ERROR, 8000-TERMINATION (CICS RETURN)
rules.statement: Any other ACCTDAT READ response (not NORMAL or NOTFND) sends an error record 'ERROR WHILE READING ACCTFILE' with the RESP/RESP2 values to the error queue and ends the transaction; no reply is sent to the requester and remaining messages are left for a later trigger.

rules.outcome: MQPUT to OUTPUT-QUEUE-HANDLE
rules.statement: Replies are always put on the fixed queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT (not the request's ReplyToQ) with the reply MsgId and CorrelId copied from the request message, as an MQFMT-STRING message in the queue manager CCSID.

rules.outcome: NO-MORE-MSGS set (normal end) or error report and termination
rules.statement: The transaction drains the triggered input queue: it keeps getting messages (waiting up to 5 seconds each time) and commits with CICS SYNCPOINT after each one, stopping normally when MQGET returns MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE. Any other MQGET failure is reported as 'INP MQGET ERR:' on the error queue and ends the transaction.

rules.conditions: MQOPEN or MQPUT completion code other than MQCC-OK
rules.outcome: 9000-ERROR then 8000-TERMINATION
rules.statement: If the input queue or reply queue cannot be opened, or a reply cannot be put, the program writes an error record (paragraph text, condition code, reason code, queue name and 'INP MQOPEN ERR' / 'OUT MQOPEN ERR' / 'MQPUT ERR') to CARD.DEMO.ERROR and ends the transaction.

rules.conditions: EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM) response not NORMAL
rules.outcome: 9000-ERROR then 8000-TERMINATION
rules.statement: If the CICS trigger data cannot be retrieved (RETRIEVE response not NORMAL), the program reports 'CICS RETREIVE' with the RESP code to the error queue and ends without processing any request.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID mapped from EIBAID; ACUP-CHANGE-ACTION state
rules.outcome: PFK-INVALID forces CCARD-AID-ENTER
rules.statement: Only Enter, PF3, PF5 (only while validated changes await confirmation) and PF12 (only after account details have been fetched) are accepted; any other key, or PF5/PF12 outside those states, is processed as Enter.

rules.outcome: SYNCPOINT, XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA); CDEMO-USRTYP-USER and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER set
rules.statement: PF3 ends the update dialog: the program takes a SYNCPOINT and transfers control (XCTL) to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM with CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, or to COMEN01C / CM00 when the caller fields are blank, recording CAUP/COACTUPC as the new caller.

rules.conditions: ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE or ACUP-CHANGES-FAILED at task start
rules.outcome: INITIALIZE WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA WS-MISC-STORAGE CDEMO-ACCT-ID; 3000-SEND-MAP; ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED
rules.statement: On the interaction after an update finished (state 'C') or failed (state 'L' lock error or 'F' update failed), the program clears its program area, working storage and CDEMO-ACCT-ID and shows the empty search screen again, so a new account must be entered.

rules.outcome: LOW-VALUES moved to the ACUP-NEW-* field (and CC-ACCT-ID for the account id); required-field edits later report it as not supplied
rules.statement: An input field keyed as '*' or left as spaces is treated as not supplied and stored as LOW-VALUES; until an account has been fetched, only the account number is taken from the screen.

rules.outcome: COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-<amount>-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL-C(<input>)
rules.statement: Credit limit, cash credit limit, current balance, current cycle credit and current cycle debit may be keyed in currency format; when FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C accepts the text, FUNCTION NUMVAL-C converts it into the signed 10.2 numeric field used for display and for the rewrite.

rules.outcome: 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT then GO TO 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS-EXIT
rules.statement: Until an account has been fetched, only the account number is edited and no other field edit runs; a blank account number ends with the message 'No input received'.

rules.outcome: WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS = LOW-VALUES; exit without editing
rules.statement: Field edits are skipped and all edit flags cleared when nothing changed, when the changes were already validated and await PF5 confirmation, or when they were already committed; values validated once are not edited again on the confirming key press.

rules.outcome: 9000-READ-ACCT; ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS when FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER
rules.statement: When no account is shown yet, or the user presses PF12, the program re-reads the account (cross-reference, account and customer) for a valid account number and shows the stored values; PF12 therefore discards any unsaved changes.

rules.outcome: ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED only when no INPUT-ERROR and a change exists
rules.statement: While details are shown, input with edit errors or with no change stays on the change screen without any update; only error-free changed input moves to the 'awaiting confirmation' state.

rules.outcome: 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING; ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR / ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED / ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS / ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE
rules.statement: The account and customer are written only when the user presses PF5 while validated changes await confirmation. The outcome sets the next state: account lock failure gives 'L', a failed rewrite gives 'F', a concurrent change returns to showing details, and any other outcome is treated as success 'C'. Without PF5 the confirmation screen is shown again.

rules.conditions: WHEN OTHER in the action EVALUATE, or any abend after HANDLE ABEND
rules.outcome: EXEC CICS SEND FROM(ABEND-DATA); EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999')
rules.statement: A change-action state not handled by 2000-DECIDE-ACTION abends the task: ABEND-CODE '0001', message 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO', the abend data is sent to the terminal and the task abends with code 9999. Any other CICS abend is routed to the same routine with 'UNEXPECTED ABEND OCCURRED.'.

rules.outcome: DFHBMFSE on editable fields; DFHBMPRF on ACSTNUMA and ACSCTRYA
rules.statement: Fields are editable only while details are shown or after edit errors; before fetch only the account number is editable, and during confirmation and after commit everything is protected. The customer id and the country code are always protected, so they cannot be changed from this screen.

rules.conditions: FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK after 9200; DID-NOT-FIND-* message conditions after 9300 and 9400
rules.outcome: GO TO 9000-READ-ACCT-EXIT on failure; otherwise 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA
rules.statement: Account details are fetched in sequence: card cross-reference by account id, then the account master, then the customer master using the customer id from the cross-reference; a missing cross-reference stops the fetch before the account is read.

rules.conditions: WS-RESP-CD NOTFND or OTHER after EXEC CICS READ
messages: not found in Cross ref file.  Resp:
not found in Acct Master file.Resp:
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK or FLG-CUSTFILTER-NOT-OK, WS-RETURN-MSG
rules.statement: A NOTFND on the cross-reference, account or customer read is an input error: the account (or customer) filter is flagged and a message naming the key, file, RESP and RESP2 is shown; any other response shows 'File Error: READ on <file> returned RESP ..,RESP2 ..'.

rules.conditions: Any field of ACCOUNT-RECORD/CUSTOMER-RECORD differs from ACUP-OLD-DETAILS
messages: Record changed by some one else. Please review
rules.outcome: DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE; no REWRITE; 2000-DECIDE-ACTION returns to ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS
rules.statement: Optimistic concurrency check: after reading both records for update, every stored account and customer value is compared with the value captured when the screen was filled; any difference cancels the save with 'Record changed by some one else. Please review'. Group id is compared case-insensitively (lower case), customer text fields upper-cased.

rules.conditions: WS-RESP-CD not NORMAL on READ ... UPDATE
messages: Could not lock account record for update
Could not lock customer record for update
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR; message (when none set yet); GO TO 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT
rules.statement: Before updating, the account record and then the customer record are read with UPDATE (locked); if either read fails the save is abandoned with 'Could not lock account record for update' or 'Could not lock customer record for update'.

rules.conditions: WS-RESP-CD not NORMAL after REWRITE ACCTDAT / CUSTDAT
rules.outcome: LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED; ROLLBACK on customer failure
rules.statement: The account record is rewritten first and then the customer record; a failed account rewrite stops with 'Update of record failed', and a failed customer rewrite sets the same message and issues SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK so the account rewrite is backed out.

rules.outcome: ACCT-UPDATE-*-DATE, CUST-UPDATE-PHONE-NUM-1/2, CUST-UPDATE-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD, CUST-UPDATE-SSN populated
rules.statement: On save, open, expiry, reissue and birth dates are stored as YYYY-MM-DD built from the keyed parts, and each phone number is stored as (AAA)BBB-CCCC from its three parts; amounts are taken from the NUMVAL-C converted fields and the SSN from the 9-digit concatenation of its parts.

rules.anchor: WHEN EIBAID IS EQUAL TO DFHPF13 SET CCARD-AID-PFK01 TO TRUE
rules.outcome: CCARD-AID-PFK01 .. CCARD-AID-PFK12 set
rules.statement: PF13 through PF24 are treated as PF1 through PF12 (for example PF15 acts as PF3 and PF17 as PF5); Enter, Clear, PA1 and PA2 are recorded as such.

rules.anchor: WHEN CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-MENUPGM AND NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER
rules.conditions: EIBCALEN = 0, or CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = 'COMEN01C' and not CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, or ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED with CDEMO-PGM-ENTER
messages: Enter or update id of account to update
rules.outcome: INITIALIZE; 3000-SEND-MAP; CDEMO-PGM-REENTER; ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED
rules.statement: A first entry (no commarea, or arrival from the main menu COMEN01C that is not a re-entry) starts a fresh dialog: commarea and program state are initialized and the empty search screen prompting for the account id is sent.

rules.outcome: XCTL to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
rules.statement: PF3 on the account view returns to the program and transaction that invoked it (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM / CDEMO-FROM-TRANID); when these are blank or low-values the main menu COMEN01C / CM00 is used. Before the XCTL the commarea is stamped with from-transaction CAVW and from-program COACTVWC, user type is forced to 'U' (CDEMO-USRTYP-USER), program context to first-entry and last map/mapset to CACTVWA/COACTVW.

rules.conditions: AID not ENTER and not PF3
rules.outcome: Processed as ENTER
rules.statement: Only ENTER and PF3 are meaningful on the account view; any other attention key (including PF keys, CLEAR, PA1/PA2) is silently treated as ENTER. PF13-PF24 are folded onto PF1-PF12, so PF15 also exits.

rules.outcome: Screen sent; account lookup only after successful edit
rules.statement: On first entry (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER) the account view only displays the empty search screen; on re-entry it edits the input and, only when the input is valid, reads the account data before redisplaying. When the program is entered from COMEN01C without the re-enter flag (or with no commarea) the shared commarea is re-initialised.

rules.outcome: SEND TEXT + RETURN (session ends)
rules.statement: If the program context is neither first-entry nor re-entry (and PF3 not pressed), the account view ends the conversation by sending the plain-text message 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' and returning to CICS without a next transaction (abend code '0001' is prepared but no abend is issued).

rules.outcome: ACCOUNT-RECORD and CUSTOMER-RECORD loaded; CDEMO-CUST-ID / CDEMO-CARD-NUM set from xref
rules.statement: An account is looked up in three steps: the card cross-reference via the account alternate index CXACAIX gives the customer id and a card number; then the account master ACCTDAT is read by account id; then the customer master CUSTDAT is read by the customer id obtained from the cross-reference. If the account is not in the cross-reference, the account and customer masters are not read.

rules.conditions: CXACAIX READ RESP NOTFND or other non-NORMAL
rules.outcome: Error message displayed, no account data
rules.statement: An account id not present in the card cross-reference file is rejected with 'Account:<id> not found in Cross ref file.  Resp:<resp> Reas:<resp2>'; any other xref read failure is reported as 'File Error: READ on CXACAIX returned RESP ...'. Both set INPUT-ERROR and mark the account filter invalid (red).

rules.conditions: ACCTDAT or CUSTDAT READ RESP NOTFND / other
rules.outcome: Error message displayed
rules.statement: When the account master has no record for the account the screen shows 'Account:<id> not found in Acct Master file.Resp:...'; when the customer master has no record for the cross-referenced customer it shows 'CustId:<id> not found in customer master.Resp: ...'. Other read failures show the generic 'File Error: READ on <file> returned RESP ...' text. All set INPUT-ERROR.

rules.outcome: Screen fields ACSTTUSO..AADDGRPO, ACSTNUMO, ACSTSSNO etc. populated
rules.statement: Account financial and date fields are displayed when the account or customer record was found; customer fields are displayed only when the customer record was found, with the 9-digit SSN reformatted as NNN-NN-NNNN (full SSN, not masked).

rules.conditions: WS-OPTION NOT NUMERIC or > CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT or = 0
messages: Please enter a valid option number...
rules.outcome: Error flag set, menu redisplayed with message
rules.statement: The admin menu option must be numeric, non-zero and not greater than CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT (6 in COADM02Y); otherwise the menu is redisplayed with 'Please enter a valid option number...'. Trailing blanks are trimmed and remaining blanks replaced by zeros before the check.

rules.outcome: Message displayed, RETURN TRANSID(CA00)
rules.statement: When the program of a selected admin option is not defined to CICS (PGMIDERR on XCTL), the admin menu does not abend: it shows 'This option is not installed ...' in green, redisplays the menu and continues the conversation with transaction CA00.

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: Sign-on transfer, menu display, option processing or invalid-key message
rules.statement: The admin menu distinguishes first entry from re-entry with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT: entered from another program it sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and only displays the menu; input is processed only on re-entry. A start without commarea is sent to sign-on COSGN00C. Any key other than ENTER or PF3 redisplays the menu with 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

rules.conditions: First entry (not CDEMO-PGM-REENTER) and CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED not blank
rules.outcome: ACTIDINI pre-filled and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY performed
rules.statement: On first entry, if the commarea carries a pre-selected value in CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED (not spaces and not low-values), it is used as the account id and processed immediately as if ENTER had been pressed (account read and balance shown with confirmation prompt).

rules.conditions: Re-entry with EIBAID = DFHPF3 / DFHPF4 / other
messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: XCTL to previous program / screen cleared / invalid-key message
rules.statement: On the bill-payment screen PF3 returns to the program recorded in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, or to the main menu COMEN01C when it is blank; PF4 clears the account, balance and confirmation fields; any other key except ENTER redisplays the screen with 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' TO
messages: Acct ID can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: Error flag set, message displayed
rules.statement: The account id is mandatory for a bill payment: when ACTIDINI is spaces or low-values the screen is redisplayed with 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' and nothing is read. No numeric or length check is made on the account id before it is moved to the numeric key ACCT-ID.

messages: Confirm to make a bill payment...
rules.outcome: Pay / cancel / show balance and prompt / reject
rules.statement: The confirmation field drives the payment: 'Y' or 'y' authorises the payment (account read for update and payment processed); 'N' or 'n' cancels and clears the screen; blank or low-values only looks up the account and shows its balance with the prompt 'Confirm to make a bill payment...'; any other value is rejected with 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'.

rules.conditions: ACCT-CURR-BAL <= 0 and account id present and no earlier error
rules.outcome: Error flag set, message displayed
rules.statement: A bill payment is refused when the account's current balance is zero or negative: the screen shows 'You have nothing to pay...' and no transaction is written.

messages: Confirm to make a bill payment...
rules.outcome: Payment transaction written and account updated, or confirmation prompt
rules.statement: The payment is executed only when the user confirmed with Y (CONF-PAY-YES) and no earlier error occurred; otherwise the balance is displayed with the prompt 'Confirm to make a bill payment...'.

rules.outcome: TRAN-ID = last TRAN-ID + 1
rules.statement: The new transaction id is the highest existing TRAN-ID in TRANSACT plus 1: the program starts a browse at HIGH-VALUES, reads the previous (last) record, ends the browse and adds 1 to its id as a 16-digit number. If the file is empty (ENDFILE) the id starts from 0, giving 1.

rules.outcome: TRAN-RECORD written to TRANSACT
rules.statement: The bill-payment transaction record is built with type code '02', category code 2, source 'POS TERM', description 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE', amount equal to the full current account balance, the card number from the account's cross-reference record, merchant id 999999999, merchant name 'BILL PAYMENT', merchant city and zip 'N/A', and origination and processing timestamps both set to the current CICS time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.000000).

rules.outcome: ACCT-CURR-BAL becomes 0 and ACCTDAT is rewritten
rules.statement: A bill payment always pays the entire outstanding balance: TRAN-AMT is set to ACCT-CURR-BAL and the new balance is ACCT-CURR-BAL - TRAN-AMT (i.e. zero), which is rewritten to the account master. Partial payments are not supported.

rules.conditions: TRANSACT WRITE RESP NORMAL / DUPKEY / DUPREC / other
messages: Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...
rules.outcome: Success or error message
rules.statement: After writing the payment transaction the user sees 'Payment successful.  Your Transaction ID is <id>.' in green and the input fields are cleared; a duplicate transaction key gives 'Tran ID already exist...' and any other write failure 'Unable to Add Bill pay Transaction...'.

rules.conditions: ACCTDAT READ UPDATE RESP NOTFND / other
rules.outcome: Error flag set, message displayed
rules.statement: An account id not found in the account master is rejected with 'Account ID NOT found...'; any other read failure shows 'Unable to lookup Account...'. Both stop the payment.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...' TO
rules.conditions: CXACAIX READ or ACCTDAT REWRITE not NORMAL
messages: Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...
rules.outcome: Error message displayed
rules.statement: A missing card cross-reference for the account shows 'Account ID NOT found...' and other xref read errors 'Unable to lookup XREF AIX file...'; an account rewrite failure shows 'Account ID NOT found...' (NOTFND) or 'Unable to Update Account...'. These set the error flag but do not stop or undo the remaining payment steps (see observations).

rules.outcome: XCTL to COSGN00C with commarea
rules.statement: When returning to a previous screen and no target program is set, the bill-payment program goes to the sign-on program COSGN00C; the commarea is stamped with from-transaction CB00, from-program COBIL00C and context 0. A start without commarea (EIBCALEN = 0) is sent to COSGN00C.

rules.outcome: WS-RETURN-MSG displayed; RETURN-CODE = 4; loop continues until end of file.
rules.statement: Any record-level failure (invalid record type, SQL error, or row not found) is reported by displaying the message and setting the job return code to 4, but processing continues with the next input record; successful records before and after are still applied.

rules.conditions: INPUT-REC-TYPE = 'A'; INSERT of TR_TYPE = INPUT-REC-NUMBER, TR_DESCRIPTION = INPUT-REC-DESC.
rules.outcome: SQLCODE 0: 'RECORD INSERTED SUCCESSFULLY'. SQLCODE < 0: message 'Error accessing: TRANSACTION_TYPE table. SQLCODE:' + code, 9999-ABEND.
rules.statement: Adding a transaction type succeeds only when the INSERT returns SQLCODE 0; any negative SQLCODE (for example a duplicate TR_TYPE) is reported as a TRANSACTION_TYPE table access error with the SQLCODE and sets RC 4.

rules.conditions: INPUT-REC-TYPE = 'U'; UPDATE ... SET TR_DESCRIPTION = :INPUT-REC-DESC WHERE TR_TYPE = :INPUT-REC-NUMBER.
rules.outcome: 0: 'RECORD UPDATED SUCCESSFULLY'; +100: 'No records found.' + 9999-ABEND; <0: table error + 9999-ABEND.
rules.statement: An update record for a transaction type code that does not exist in TRANSACTION_TYPE (SQLCODE +100) is rejected with 'No records found.' and RC 4; negative SQLCODEs are reported as table access errors. Only TR_DESCRIPTION is changed; TR_TYPE is the key.

rules.outcome: 0: 'RECORD DELETED SUCCESSFULLY'; +100: 'No records found.' + 9999-ABEND; <0: table error + 9999-ABEND.
rules.statement: A delete record for a transaction type code that does not exist (SQLCODE +100) is rejected with 'No records found.' and RC 4; negative SQLCODEs (for example a referential constraint from TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY) are reported as table access errors with RC 4.

rules.conditions: EIBCALEN = 0, or CDEMO-PGM-ENTER and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM not COCRDLIC
rules.outcome: WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA initialised; CA-FIRST-PAGE, CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN
rules.statement: The card list starts afresh (first page, paging keys cleared, last page not shown) whenever it is entered in first-entry mode from a different program, e.g. from the main menu; with no commarea at all it also creates a new commarea with from-transaction CCLI, from-program COCRDLIC and user type 'U'.

rules.outcome: Treated as ENTER
rules.statement: On the card list only ENTER, PF3, PF7 and PF8 are recognised; any other attention key is processed as ENTER. Screen input is received and edited only when the list re-enters itself (commarea present and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = COCRDLIC).

rules.outcome: XCTL COMEN01C with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
rules.statement: PF3 pressed on the card list always returns to the main menu COMEN01C (not to the caller): the commarea is stamped with from CCLI/COCRDLIC, user type 'U', first-entry context and last map, then XCTL to COMEN01C.

rules.outcome: Screen redisplayed with error message; list re-read only for selection errors
rules.statement: When the input has errors the list is redisplayed with the error; the card file is re-read only when both filters are valid (i.e. the error is in the row selections). With an invalid account or card filter no records are read and the selection column is protected.

rules.outcome: Same page redisplayed with message
rules.statement: PF7 on the first page does not page: the current page is re-read from its first card and the message 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' is shown.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID-PFK03 (from other program) or CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM not COCRDLIC
rules.outcome: CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and paging context initialised; first page listed
rules.statement: When control comes back to the card list from another program (re-entry flag set but from-program not COCRDLIC, or PF3 still set as AID), the commarea is re-initialised and the list restarts at page 1, discarding filters and the previously selected account/card.

rules.outcome: Next 7 matching cards listed
rules.statement: PF8 pages forward only when a next page exists: the page number is increased by 1 and the browse restarts at the saved last-card key (the first record after the current page). Without a next page, PF8 falls to the default branch and redisplays the current page.

rules.outcome: Previous page listed
rules.statement: PF7 when not on the first page pages backward: the page number is decreased by 1 and the 7 matching cards preceding the current page's first card are read backwards.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID-ENTER, VIEW-REQUESTED-ON(I-SELECTED), no input error, re-entry from itself
rules.outcome: XCTL COCRDSLC with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
rules.statement: ENTER with 'S' against one listed card transfers to the card detail program COCRDSLC, passing that row's account number in CDEMO-ACCT-ID and card number in CDEMO-CARD-NUM, with from CCLI/COCRDLIC, user type 'U' and first-entry context.

rules.outcome: XCTL COCRDUPC with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
rules.statement: ENTER with 'U' against one listed card transfers to the card update program COCRDUPC, passing that row's account number and card number in the commarea, with from CCLI/COCRDLIC, user type 'U' and first-entry context.

rules.outcome: Page listed from WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM
rules.statement: In all other cases (ENTER without a selection, first display, PF8 with no next page) the list is (re)displayed starting from the first card key of the current page; on a fresh start this key is empty, so the list starts at the beginning of the card file.

messages: TYPE S FOR DETAIL, U TO UPDATE ANY RECORD
rules.outcome: Error or info message on the list screen
rules.statement: Paging messages: PF8 when no next page exists first shows the action hint 'TYPE S FOR DETAIL, U TO UPDATE ANY RECORD' and marks the last page as shown; a further PF8 shows 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY'. The hint is also shown whenever a next page exists or no other info is set. Filter errors suppress these messages.

rules.anchor: 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER'
rules.conditions: CC-ACCT-ID blank/zero -> no filter; NOT NUMERIC -> error
messages: ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER
rules.outcome: FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK / NOT-OK / ISVALID; CDEMO-ACCT-ID set or zeroed
rules.statement: The account filter is optional: spaces, low-values or all zeros mean no account filter. If supplied it must be numeric over all 11 positions; otherwise the input is rejected with 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER', the account filter is shown in red and row selection is protected.

rules.anchor: 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER'
rules.conditions: CC-CARD-NUM blank/zero -> no filter; NOT NUMERIC -> error
messages: CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER
rules.outcome: FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK / NOT-OK / ISVALID; CDEMO-CARD-NUM set or zeroed
rules.statement: The card number filter is optional: spaces, low-values or all zeros mean no card filter. If supplied it must be numeric over all 16 positions; otherwise the input is rejected with 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' (only if no account-filter message is already set) and row selection is protected.

messages: PLEASE SELECT ONLY ONE RECORD TO VIEW OR UPDATE
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR; message; row error flags set
rules.statement: Only one card may be selected per request: if more than one row carries 'S' or 'U', the input is rejected with 'PLEASE SELECT ONLY ONE RECORD TO VIEW OR UPDATE' and every selected row is highlighted as an error. Selection editing is skipped when a filter is invalid.

rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR; row flagged; message
rules.statement: Valid row action codes are 'S' (view detail), 'U' (update) or blank. Any other code marks the row in error and rejects the input with 'INVALID ACTION CODE' (unless another message is already set). The row with S/U becomes the selected row (I-SELECTED).

rules.outcome: WS-SCREEN-ROWS filled; WS-CA-FIRST-CARDKEY and WS-CA-LAST-CARDKEY saved
rules.statement: A page holds at most 7 cards (WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES). Reading forward from the start key in card-number order, only records passing the filters are placed on the page; the first placed card's key becomes the page's first-card key, and the page number is set to 1 if it was 0.

rules.conditions: Lookahead READNEXT result; ENDFILE; WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM = 1 and WS-SCRN-COUNTER = 0
messages: NO RECORDS FOUND FOR THIS SEARCH CONDITION.
rules.outcome: CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS / NOT-EXISTS; message
rules.statement: After the 7th card is placed, one more record is read (without filtering) to decide whether a next page exists; its key becomes the start key for PF8. Reaching end of file sets 'no next page' and the message 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW'; if page 1 has no matching card at all, the message is 'NO RECORDS FOUND FOR THIS SEARCH CONDITION.'.

rules.outcome: Loop ends; file-error message
rules.statement: Any card-file read failure other than end of file stops the list fill and shows 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT returned RESP <resp>,RESP2 <resp2>' on the screen; the rows read so far are still displayed.

rules.outcome: WS-SCREEN-ROWS filled bottom-up; WS-CA-FIRST-CARDKEY updated
rules.statement: Paging backward reads the card file in descending card-number order from the current page's first card, skips that card itself, and fills rows 7 down to 1 with the preceding cards that pass the filters; the card placed in row 1 becomes the new first-card key. A read error (including reaching the start of the file) ends the fill with the file-error message.

rules.outcome: WS-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD or WS-DONOT-EXCLUDE-THIS-RECORD
rules.statement: Record selection filter: a card is listed only if it matches every supplied filter - its CARD-ACCT-ID equals the account filter when a valid account filter was entered, and its CARD-NUM equals the card filter when a valid card filter was entered. With no filters all cards are listed.

rules.anchor: IF CDEMO-FROM-TRANID EQUAL LOW-VALUES OR CDEMO-FROM-TRANID EQUAL SPACES MOVE LIT-MENUTRANID TO CDEMO-TO-TRANID
rules.conditions: AID key is PF3 (or PF15, folded to PF3)
rules.outcome: XCTL to caller or COMEN01C with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; CDEMO-USRTYP-USER and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER set
rules.statement: When PF3 is pressed the program transfers control (XCTL) back to the program and transaction recorded in CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM / CDEMO-FROM-TRANID; when either is LOW-VALUES or SPACES the main menu COMEN01C / transaction CM00 is used instead. Before leaving it records itself as the from-program, sets the user type to regular user and the context to first entry.

rules.anchor: IF PFK-INVALID SET CCARD-AID-ENTER TO TRUE
rules.conditions: CCARD-AID is neither ENTER nor PFK03
rules.outcome: CCARD-AID-ENTER is set and processing continues as for ENTER; no error message
rules.statement: Only ENTER and PF3 are accepted on the card detail screen; any other attention key is silently treated as ENTER.

rules.anchor: WHEN CDEMO-PGM-ENTER AND CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-CCLISTPGM
rules.outcome: INPUT-OK; CDEMO-ACCT-ID/CDEMO-CARD-NUM moved to CC-ACCT-ID-N/CC-CARD-NUM-N; 9000-READ-DATA then screen sent
rules.statement: When the program is first entered from the card list program COCRDLIC, the account and card number passed in the commarea are treated as already validated: the card is read and its details displayed without editing the inputs.

rules.conditions: CDEMO-PGM-ENTER (not from COCRDLIC) or CDEMO-PGM-REENTER with INPUT-ERROR / no error
rules.outcome: Screen sent; card read only when all input edits passed
rules.statement: On first entry from any program other than COCRDLIC the search screen is shown without reading data; on re-entry the typed criteria are edited and, if any edit fails, the screen is redisplayed with the error, otherwise the card is read and displayed.

rules.conditions: WHEN OTHER of the main EVALUATE
rules.outcome: SEND TEXT then CICS RETURN without TRANSID
rules.statement: If the program context matches none of the expected scenarios, the program sends the plain-text message 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' and ends the conversation (no abend is issued even though ABEND-CODE '0001' is prepared).

rules.conditions: CICS READ response NORMAL / NOTFND / other
messages: Did not find cards for this search condition
rules.outcome: FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT on success; INPUT-ERROR with message otherwise
rules.statement: The card is looked up in CARDDAT by card number only; the entered account number is not part of the key and is not compared with CARD-ACCT-ID. Not found produces 'Did not find cards for this search condition' and marks both filters in error; any other response produces a 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT returned RESP ... ,RESP2 ...' message.

rules.anchor: MOVE DFHBMPRF TO ACCTSIDA OF CCRDSLAI
rules.outcome: ACCTSIDA/CARDSIDA = DFHBMPRF, else DFHBMFSE
rules.statement: When the card detail screen was reached from the card list (last mapset COCRDLI and caller COCRDLIC), the account and card number fields are protected so the user cannot change the selection; otherwise they are enterable.

rules.anchor: IF CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET EQUAL LIT-CCLISTMAPSET MOVE ZEROS TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID
rules.outcome: SYNCPOINT; XCTL with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; CDEMO-USRTYP-USER and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER set
rules.statement: The program exits when PF3 is pressed, or automatically when an update has completed or failed and the user originally came from the card list (last mapset COCRDLI). It commits (SYNCPOINT) and XCTLs to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM/TRANID, or to COMEN01C/CM00 when those are blank; when returning to the card list the account and card numbers in the commarea are zeroed.

rules.outcome: Invalid keys silently mapped to CCARD-AID-ENTER
rules.statement: Accepted keys are ENTER, PF3, PF5 only when changes have been validated but not yet confirmed, and PF12 only after card details have been fetched; any other key is treated as ENTER.

rules.anchor: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 AND CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-CCLISTPGM
rules.outcome: 9000-READ-DATA; CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS; screen sent
rules.statement: On first entry from the card list COCRDLIC (or PF12 when the caller is COCRDLIC), the account and card from the commarea are trusted as valid keys: the card is read and its details shown for editing without key edits.

rules.conditions: CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED and CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, or CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = 'COMEN01C' and not re-enter
messages: Please enter Account and Card Number
rules.outcome: WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA initialized; search screen sent; state not fetched / re-enter
rules.statement: On a fresh entry (details not fetched and first entry, or first entry from the main menu) the program shows an empty search screen asking for account and card number.

rules.anchor: WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED INITIALIZE WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA
rules.outcome: State reset to not fetched; search screen sent
rules.statement: After an update has completed or failed (and the user did not come from the card list), the next interaction resets the update state, working storage and the commarea account/card numbers and prompts for new search keys.

rules.conditions: WHEN OTHER of the main EVALUATE
rules.outcome: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, 3000-SEND-MAP
rules.statement: In every other situation the screen input is received and edited, the next action is decided from the update state, and the screen is redisplayed.

rules.anchor: IF CRDNAMEI OF CCRDUPAI = '*' OR CRDNAMEI OF CCRDUPAI = SPACES
rules.outcome: LOW-VALUES moved to CC-ACCT-ID/CC-CARD-NUM/CCUP-NEW-* fields
rules.statement: An input of '*' or spaces in the account, card, name, status, expiry month or expiry year field is treated as not supplied (LOW-VALUES); the expiry day is taken from the screen as is.

rules.conditions: CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED or PF12; both key flags valid; card found
rules.outcome: CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS set
rules.statement: When details are not yet fetched, or the user presses PF12 to cancel changes, the card is (re)read only if both the account and card keys are valid; if found, the state becomes show details, discarding any edits.

rules.anchor: IF INPUT-ERROR OR NO-CHANGES-DETECTED CONTINUE ELSE SET CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED TO TRUE
rules.outcome: State N or unchanged
rules.statement: While details are shown, changes become 'validated, awaiting confirmation' only when there is no input error and a change was detected; when edits failed the state stays 'changes not OK' and the user must correct the fields.

rules.anchor: WHEN DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE SET CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS TO TRUE
rules.outcome: 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING; CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION set to L, F, S or C
rules.statement: Validated changes are saved only when the user confirms with PF5. The outcome sets the state: lock failure -> 'L' (Changes unsuccessful), rewrite failure -> 'F' (Changes unsuccessful), record changed by another user -> back to show details with the refreshed values, otherwise 'C' (Changes committed to database).

rules.anchor: WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE SET CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS TO TRUE
rules.conditions: State N without PF5; state C
rules.outcome: No action, or CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS with commarea keys zeroed
rules.statement: Without PF5 a validated change is simply redisplayed awaiting confirmation. After a successful save the details are shown again; when there is no calling transaction the commarea account, card and account status are cleared.

rules.outcome: CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999')
rules.statement: An update state not handled by the decision logic is treated as a program error: ABEND-ROUTINE sends 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO' and the task abends with code 9999.

rules.anchor: INSPECT CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME CONVERTING LIT-LOWER TO LIT-UPPER
rules.outcome: CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD, CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME, CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR/MON/DAY, CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD populated
rules.statement: When the card is found, the values fetched for later comparison are saved with the embossed name converted to upper case and the expiry date split into year (1-4), month (6-7) and day (9-10).

messages: Did not find cards for this search condition
rules.outcome: FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT or INPUT-ERROR with message
rules.statement: The card to update is located in CARDDAT by card number only; the account number is not part of the key and is not compared with CARD-ACCT-ID. Not found gives 'Did not find cards for this search condition'; other responses give a 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT' message.

messages: Could not lock record for update
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR; message set; no rewrite
rules.statement: If the card record cannot be read for update (lock), the update is abandoned with 'Could not lock record for update'.

messages: Record changed by some one else. Please review
rules.outcome: No REWRITE; CCUP-OLD-* refreshed; state returns to show details
rules.statement: Optimistic concurrency: before rewriting, the locked record's CVV, upper-cased embossed name, expiry year/month/day and active status must equal the values fetched when the details were shown; otherwise the update is not applied, the message 'Record changed by some one else. Please review' is set and the stored old values are refreshed from the current record.

rules.outcome: EXEC CICS REWRITE FILE(CARDDAT); LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED on error
rules.statement: The rewritten card record is built from the screen values: card number, account number from the (protected) account field, CVV from CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD, embossed name as typed, expiry date formatted 'YYYY-MM-DD' from new year, month and day, and the new active status. A REWRITE failure sets 'Update of record failed'.

rules.anchor: WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE MOVE DFHBMPRF TO ACCTSIDA OF CCRDUPAI
rules.outcome: DFHBMFSE / DFHBMPRF attributes on input fields
rules.statement: Which fields may be edited depends on the update state: before fetch only the account and card keys are enterable; while showing details or correcting errors only name, status, expiry month and year are enterable; once validated or saved all fields are protected. The expiry day is never enterable.

rules.conditions: A request message was received successfully
rules.outcome: Date/time text reply put on CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE
rules.statement: Every request message, whatever its content, is answered with the current CICS system date and time as text: 'SYSTEM DATE : ' followed by the date in MM-DD-YYYY form and 'SYSTEM TIME : ' followed by the time formatted by FORMATTIME with a time separator.

rules.outcome: MQPUT to OUTPUT-QUEUE-HANDLE
rules.statement: Replies are always put on the fixed queue CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE (not the request's ReplyToQ) with MsgId and CorrelId copied from the request, as an MQFMT-STRING message in the queue manager CCSID.

rules.outcome: NO-MORE-MSGS set (normal end) or error report and termination
rules.statement: The transaction drains the triggered input queue: it keeps getting messages (waiting up to 5 seconds each) and commits with CICS SYNCPOINT after each one, stopping normally when MQGET returns MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE. Any other MQGET failure is reported as 'INP MQGET ERR:' on the error queue and ends the transaction.

rules.conditions: MQOPEN or MQPUT completion code other than MQCC-OK
rules.outcome: 9000-ERROR then 8000-TERMINATION
rules.statement: If the input queue or reply queue cannot be opened, or a reply cannot be put, the program writes an error record (condition code, reason code, queue name and 'INP MQOPEN ERR' / 'OUT MQOPEN ERR' / 'MQPUT ERR') to CARD.DEMO.ERROR and ends the transaction.

rules.conditions: EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM) response not NORMAL
rules.outcome: 9000-ERROR then 8000-TERMINATION
rules.statement: If the CICS trigger data cannot be retrieved (RETRIEVE response not NORMAL), the program reports 'CICS RETRIEVE' with the RESP code to the error queue and ends without processing any request.

rules.conditions: WS-OPTION IS NOT NUMERIC or WS-OPTION > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT or WS-OPTION = 0
messages: Please enter a valid option number...
rules.outcome: Error flag set; menu redisplayed with message; no transfer
rules.statement: The menu option entered must be numeric, not zero and not greater than the number of configured options (CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT, 11 in COMEN02Y); otherwise the menu is redisplayed with 'Please enter a valid option number...'. Before the test, trailing blanks are dropped and embedded/leading blanks are replaced by zeros, so ' 5' and '5 ' both mean option 5.

rules.outcome: Error flag set; menu redisplayed with message
rules.statement: A regular user (CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'U') may not select a menu option flagged admin-only (CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE = 'A'); the menu is redisplayed with 'No access - Admin Only option... ' and no transfer happens. In the current COMEN02Y table every option is flagged 'U', so the check never fires with the shipped configuration.

rules.conditions: Error flag off and option program not COPAUS0C and not starting 'DUMMY'
rules.outcome: XCTL to option program with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA
rules.statement: A valid, permitted option whose program is neither COPAUS0C nor a DUMMY placeholder transfers control (XCTL) to the program named in CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME for that option, passing the commarea with from-transaction CM00, from-program COMEN01C and program context 0 (first entry). Options 1-10 map to COACTVWC, COACTUPC, COCRDLIC, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC, COTRN00C, COTRN01C, COTRN02C, CORPT00C, COBIL00C.

rules.outcome: No commarea: XCTL to COSGN00C. First entry: menu sent. Re-entry: map received and key processed.
rules.statement: The menu distinguishes first entry from re-entry with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT: when entered from another program (context not 1) it sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and only displays the menu; screen input is received and acted on only on re-entry. A call without any commarea is sent back to sign-on (COSGN00C).

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: Menu redisplayed with invalid-key message
rules.statement: On the main menu any key other than ENTER or PF3 is rejected: the menu is redisplayed with 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...' and no option is processed.

rules.outcome: Loop ends; task terminates (DLI TERM, MQCLOSE, CICS RETURN). Remaining messages wait for a new trigger.
rules.statement: A triggered COPAUA0C task processes request messages until the queue is empty (5-second MQGET wait) or until more than 500 requests (WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT) have been processed, committing with CICS SYNCPOINT after each request.

rules.conditions: CARD-FOUND-XREF after CCXREF read by PA-RQ-CARD-NUM
rules.outcome: Card not found: decision runs (declined) and response sent, but no IMS write.
rules.statement: Account, customer and IMS summary data are looked up only when the card number is found in the card cross-reference file; the authorization is written to the IMS database (summary update and detail insert) only for cards found in the cross-reference. A response is always returned.

rules.conditions: FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG -> PA-CREDIT-LIMIT - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE; else FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR -> ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT - ACCT-CURR-BAL; else decline
rules.outcome: DECLINE-AUTH and INSUFFICIENT-FUND set when amount exceeds available; DECLINE-AUTH alone when no account data.
rules.statement: Available credit is the IMS summary credit limit minus the summary credit balance when a pending-authorization summary exists for the account; otherwise it is the account master credit limit minus current balance. The request is declined for insufficient funds when the transaction amount is greater than the available credit, and declined (no reason flag) when neither summary nor account record exists.

rules.outcome: PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-CODE '05'/'00'; PA-RL-APPROVED-AMT and WS-APPROVED-AMT 0 or PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT.
rules.statement: A declined authorization returns response code '05' with approved amount 0; an approved authorization returns response code '00' with the approved amount equal to the full requested transaction amount (no partial approvals).

rules.conditions: AUTH-RESP-DECLINED, first true of the decline flags in EVALUATE order
rules.outcome: PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON set; also stored as PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON in the detail segment.
rules.statement: Decline reason codes: card, account or customer not found = '3100'; insufficient funds = '4100'; card not active = '4200'; account closed = '4300'; card fraud = '5100'; merchant fraud = '5200'; any other decline = '9000'. Approved responses carry reason '0000'.

rules.conditions: Card found in xref; NFOUND/FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG; AUTH-RESP-APPROVED
rules.outcome: DLI REPL or ISRT of PAUTSUM0.
rules.statement: When writing an authorization, the account's pending summary is created if absent (zeros, account and customer id from xref), its credit and cash limits are refreshed from the account master, and its totals are updated: approved -> approved count +1, approved amount and credit balance + approved amount, cash balance set to 0; declined -> declined count +1 and declined amount + PA-TRANSACTION-AMT. The summary is then replaced or inserted.

rules.conditions: Card found in xref (detail insert path)
rules.outcome: PAUTDTL1 inserted under PAUTSUM0 for XREF-ACCT-ID.
rules.statement: Each authorization detail is keyed by complemented date and time (PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - current YYDDD, PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - HHMMSSmmm) so that the newest authorization sorts first, and its match status starts as 'P' (pending) when approved or 'D' (declined) when declined, with fraud fields blank.

messages: FAILED TO PUT ON REPLY MQ
rules.outcome: 9990-END-ROUTINE: terminate and CICS RETURN; no explicit rollback is issued.
rules.statement: Every error is logged to TD queue CSSL; errors classified critical (MQ open/get/put failures, unexpected VSAM responses, IMS schedule/read/update/insert failures) terminate the task immediately (DLI TERM, MQCLOSE, CICS RETURN), while not-found conditions and MQ close failures are warnings that let processing continue.

rules.anchor: IF ACCTIDI OF COPAU0AI IS NOT NUMERIC
rules.outcome: WS-ACCT-ID = LOW-VALUES, WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y', message shown, no list loaded.
rules.statement: The account id entered on the authorization summary screen is mandatory and must be numeric; otherwise the account is cleared, the error flag is set and a message is shown.

rules.conditions: Valid account id and a selection code with a saved authorization key
messages: Invalid selection. Valid value is S
rules.outcome: XCTL PROGRAM(COPAUS1C) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; otherwise message.
rules.statement: Selecting a listed authorization with 'S' or 's' transfers control to the authorization detail program COPAUS1C, passing the selected authorization key in CDEMO-CPVS-PAU-SELECTED; only the first non-blank selection field of the five rows is honoured and any other selection value is rejected.

rules.anchor: PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX > 5 OR AUTHS-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
rules.outcome: Up to 5 rows populated; CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-LAST, CDEMO-CPVS-PAUKEY-PREV-PG(page), NEXT-PAGE-YES/NO set.
rules.statement: Pending authorizations are listed five per page in IMS key order under the account's summary; a page number and the first key of each page are kept in the commarea, and one look-ahead read decides whether a next page exists.

messages: You are already at the top of the page...
You are already at the bottom of the page...
rules.outcome: Page reloaded or message shown.
rules.statement: PF7 pages backward only when the current page number is greater than 1, otherwise shows a top-of-list message; PF8 pages forward only when a next page was detected, otherwise shows a bottom-of-list message.

rules.outcome: WS-AUTH-APRV-STAT shown in PAPRVnnI.
rules.statement: In the authorization list an authorization is shown as approved ('A') when its response code is '00' and as declined ('D') for any other response code.

rules.outcome: Summary fields displayed or zero; list loaded only when summary exists.
rules.statement: Account-level authorization totals (approved/declined counts and amounts, credit and cash balances) are shown from the IMS pending authorization summary when one exists for the account; otherwise they are shown as zero and no authorization list is loaded.

rules.outcome: XCTL to COMEN01C (or COSGN00C) or message CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
rules.statement: PF3 returns to the main menu program COMEN01C; any key other than ENTER, PF3, PF7 or PF8 is rejected with the common invalid-key message. When no target program is set, return defaults to the sign-on program COSGN00C.

rules.outcome: WS-ACCT-ID/ACCTIDO set and details gathered.
rules.statement: When entered from another CardDemo program, the account id passed in the commarea is used to load the screen immediately if it is numeric; otherwise the account field is left blank and nothing is loaded.

rules.anchor: ' System error while reading AUTH Details: Code:'
messages: System error while reading AUTH Details: Code:
System error while repos. AUTH Details: Code:
System error while reading AUTH Summary: Code:
rules.outcome: WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y', message, screen sent.
rules.statement: Unexpected IMS statuses while reading the summary or detail segments set the error flag, stop further list loading and display a system-error message with the IMS status code.

rules.conditions: CDEMO-ACCT-ID numeric and CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED not spaces/low-values
rules.outcome: Read and display, or ERR-FLG-ON (no display).
rules.statement: An authorization detail is displayed only when the commarea carries a numeric account id and a non-blank selected authorization key; otherwise the error flag is set and the detail fields are left empty.

rules.outcome: PA-AUTH-FRAUD and WS-FRD-ACTION set before LINK to COPAUS2C.
rules.statement: PF5 toggles the fraud status of the displayed authorization: if it is currently confirmed fraud ('F') it becomes fraud removed ('R') and the action sent to COPAUS2C is remove; otherwise it becomes confirmed fraud ('F') and the action is report.

rules.conditions: EIBRESP NORMAL and WS-FRD-UPDATE-STATUS = 'S'; then DLI REPL status OK
messages: System error while FRAUD Tagging, ROLLBACK||
rules.outcome: SYNCPOINT with 'AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...' / 'AUTH MARKED FRAUD...', or SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK with error message.
rules.statement: The IMS detail is updated with the new fraud status only when COPAUS2C has recorded the fraud action in DB2 successfully; if the LINK fails or COPAUS2C reports failure, the unit of work is rolled back and COPAUS2C's message is shown. A failed IMS replace also rolls back both updates.

rules.outcome: AUTHRSPO/AUTHRSPC and AUTHRSNO populated.
rules.statement: The response is displayed as 'A' in green when the response code is '00' and 'D' in red otherwise; the reason code is decoded through a sorted table (0000 APPROVED, 3100 INVALID CARD, 4100 INSUFFICNT FUND, 4200 CARD NOT ACTIVE, 4300 ACCOUNT CLOSED, 4400 EXCED DAILY LMT, 5100 CARD FRAUD, 5200 MERCHANT FRAUD, 5300 LOST CARD, 9000 UNKNOWN) and shown as '9999-ERROR' when not in the table.

rules.outcome: AUTHFRDO = flag '-' report date, or '-'.
rules.statement: The fraud field shows the fraud flag and the fraud report date only when the authorization is confirmed fraud or fraud removed; otherwise it shows '-'.

rules.outcome: Next detail displayed and CDEMO-CPVD-PAU-SELECTED updated, or message.
rules.statement: PF8 shows the next pending authorization of the same account in IMS key order; when there is none the current one stays and the message 'Already at the last Authorization...' is shown.

rules.anchor: ' System error while reading Auth Summary: Code:'
messages: System error while reading Auth Summary: Code:
System error while reading Auth Details: Code:
rules.outcome: WS-ERR-FLG = 'Y', message, screen sent.
rules.statement: Unexpected IMS statuses on reading the summary or the selected detail set the error flag and display a system-error message with the IMS code; a missing summary or detail ('GE'/'GB') is treated as end of data.

rules.outcome: XCTL to COPAUS0C with CDEMO-PGM-ENTER.
rules.statement: PF3, or entry without a commarea, returns to the authorization summary program COPAUS0C.

rules.outcome: Row inserted or AUTH_FRAUD/FRAUD_RPT_DATE updated; WS-FRD-UPDATE-STATUS 'S' or 'F'.
rules.statement: A fraud report/removal is recorded in DB2 table AUTHFRDS as an insert of the full authorization; if a row already exists for the same card number and authorization timestamp (SQLCODE -803), only its fraud flag and fraud report date are updated.

rules.outcome: AUTH-TS host variable set; part of the AUTHFRDS primary key with CARD_NUM.
rules.statement: The DB2 authorization timestamp is built from the original authorization date (YYMMDD from the request) and the time recovered from the complemented key (999999999 - PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = HHMMSSmmm), formatted 'YY-MM-DD HH.MI.SSmmm000' and converted with TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.

rules.outcome: WS-FRD-UPDT-FAILED, WS-FRD-ACT-MSG set.
rules.statement: Any DB2 error other than duplicate key on insert, or any error on the update, is returned to the caller as failure ('F') with the SQLCODE and SQLSTATE in the message; the caller decides to roll back.

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: XCTL to COSGN00C/COMEN01C, screen sent, or invalid-key message
rules.statement: Without a commarea the program returns to the sign-on program COSGN00C. On first entry it shows the report selection screen; afterwards ENTER processes the request, PF3 returns to the main menu COMEN01C and any other key shows 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

rules.anchor: COMPUTE WS-CURDATE-N = FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER( FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-CURDATE-N) - 1)
rules.conditions: Monthly selection field not spaces/low-values (checked first)
rules.outcome: PARM-START-DATE-1/2 and PARM-END-DATE-1/2 set; SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR
rules.statement: Monthly report: the reporting period runs from the first day of the current month (YYYY-MM-01) to the last day of the current month, computed as the day before the first day of the next month (with year roll-over after December).

rules.conditions: Yearly selection field not spaces/low-values and Monthly blank
rules.outcome: Dates YYYY-01-01 / YYYY-12-31 set; SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR
rules.statement: Yearly report: the reporting period is January 1 to December 31 of the current year. It applies only when Monthly is not selected.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Start Date - Month can NOT be empty...'
rules.conditions: Custom selected (Monthly and Yearly blank) and a date part is spaces/low-values
messages: Start Date - Month can NOT be empty...
Start Date - Day can NOT be empty...
