Start Date - Year can NOT be empty...
End Date - Month can NOT be empty...
End Date - Day can NOT be empty...
End Date - Year can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: Error message, cursor on field, screen sent, task ends
rules.statement: Custom report: start month, start day, start year, end month, end day and end year are all required, checked in that order; the first empty one is reported ('Start Date - Month can NOT be empty...' etc.) and processing stops.

rules.anchor: IF SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC OR SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI > '12'
rules.conditions: Converted date part not numeric or out of range
messages: Start Date - Not a valid Month...
Start Date - Not a valid Day...
Start Date - Not a valid Year...
End Date - Not a valid Month...
End Date - Not a valid Day...
End Date - Not a valid Year...
rules.outcome: Error message, screen sent, task ends
rules.statement: Custom report dates: each part is converted with NUMVAL-C; month must be numeric and not greater than 12, day numeric and not greater than 31, and year numeric, for both start and end date; the first failure is reported ('Start Date - Not a valid Month...' etc.).

messages: Start Date - Not a valid date...
End Date - Not a valid date...
rules.outcome: Error message, screen sent, task ends
rules.statement: Custom start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD) must be valid calendar dates according to CSUTLDTC/CEEDAYS. A non-zero severity is rejected ('Start Date - Not a valid date...' / 'End Date - Not a valid date...') except when the CEEDAYS message number is 2513, which is accepted.

rules.outcome: SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR; success message with DFHGREEN
rules.statement: A custom report is submitted only when no validation error was raised; on success of any report the selection fields are cleared and '<Monthly|Yearly|Custom> report submitted for printing ...' is shown in green.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Select a report type to print report...' TO WS-MESSAGE
messages: Select a report type to print report...
rules.outcome: Error message, cursor on Monthly, screen sent
rules.statement: If none of Monthly, Yearly or Custom is selected, the request is rejected with 'Select a report type to print report...'. The selection fields are evaluated in priority order Monthly, Yearly, Custom.

messages: " is not a valid value to confirm...
rules.outcome: Prompt, cancel, error, or continue to job submission
rules.statement: The report job is submitted only after explicit confirmation: a blank CONFIRM field asks 'Please confirm to print the <name> report...'; 'N' or 'n' cancels and clears the screen; any value other than 'Y'/'y'/'N'/'n' is rejected with '"<value>" is not a valid value to confirm...'.

rules.anchor: IF JCL-RECORD = '/*EOF' OR JCL-RECORD = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
rules.conditions: Confirmed with Y/y and no error
rules.outcome: EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') for each JCL line
rules.statement: Job submission: the in-storage JCL deck (job TRNRPT00, JCLLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC, EXEC PROC=TRANREPT, SYMNAMES TRAN-CARD-NUM,263,16,ZD and TRAN-PROC-DT,305,10,CH, PARM-START-DATE/PARM-END-DATE symbols and a DATEPARM card with start and end date) is written one 80-byte line at a time to TDQ 'JOBS', up to and including the first line that is '/*EOF', spaces or low-values (maximum 1000 lines) or until an error occurs.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...' TO WS-MESSAGE
rules.outcome: Error message; task ends via SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN
rules.statement: If any write to TDQ 'JOBS' fails, the RESP/RESP2 codes are DISPLAYed, the error flag is set and 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...' is shown; lines already written are not removed.

rules.outcome: XCTL to COSGN00C
rules.statement: When returning to a previous screen and no target program is set, the sign-on program COSGN00C is used.

rules.conditions: EIBCALEN not zero and EIBAID = DFHPF3, or EIBAID is neither DFHENTER nor DFHPF3
messages: Thank you for using CardDemo application...
Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: PF3: SEND TEXT + RETURN (session ends). Other key: error flag set, screen redisplayed with invalid-key message.
rules.statement: On the sign-on screen PF3 ends the CardDemo session: the program sends the plain-text message 'Thank you for using CardDemo application...' and returns to CICS without a next transaction; any key other than ENTER or PF3 is rejected and the sign-on screen is redisplayed with 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

rules.conditions: USRSEC read RESP 0 and SEC-USR-PWD = WS-USER-PWD
rules.outcome: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, CDEMO-USER-ID, CDEMO-USER-TYPE set; CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 0
rules.statement: On successful sign-on the commarea passed to the menu carries the signed-on user id, the user type copied from SEC-USR-TYPE of the security record, from-transaction CC00, from-program COSGN00C and program context 0 (first entry), so the target menu starts in first-entry mode with the role from the security file.

rules.outcome: CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = 'COSGN00C'; XCTL to COSGN00C.
rules.statement: When the program is started without a COMMAREA (EIBCALEN = 0) the user is sent to the sign-on program COSGN00C instead of the transaction list.

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: DFHENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; DFHPF3 -> XCTL COMEN01C; DFHPF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY; DFHPF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY; other -> WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY shown.
rules.statement: On re-entry the attention key decides the action: Enter processes selection/filter, PF3 returns to the main menu COMEN01C, PF7 pages backward, PF8 pages forward; any other key is rejected with the invalid-key message and the list is redisplayed.

rules.anchor: WHEN SEL0001I OF COTRN0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES
rules.conditions: SELnnnnI not SPACES/LOW-VALUES, evaluated from row 1 to row 10
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG = selection value, CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED = TRNIDnnI of that row; otherwise both set to SPACES.
rules.statement: Only one row selection is honoured per Enter: the selection fields are tested in screen order SEL0001I to SEL0010I and the first non-blank one is taken together with the Tran ID of the same row; if none is filled the stored selection is cleared.

rules.conditions: CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG and CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED both not blank; flag = 'S' or 's'
messages: Invalid selection. Valid value is S
rules.outcome: 'S'/'s': CDEMO-FROM-TRANID = CT00, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = COTRN00C, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 0, XCTL COTRN01C. Other: WS-MESSAGE 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' (error flag not set; list processing continues).
rules.statement: The only valid row selection code is 'S' (upper or lower case). A valid selection on a row with a Tran ID transfers control to the transaction view program COTRN01C with the selected Tran ID in the COMMAREA; any other code is rejected with a message and the list is refreshed.

rules.anchor: IF TRNIDINI  OF COTRN0AI IS NUMERIC
rules.outcome: Blank: TRAN-ID = LOW-VALUES. Numeric: TRAN-ID = TRNIDINI. Not numeric: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', message 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...', screen sent.
rules.statement: The optional start Tran ID entered on the screen must be numeric. Blank means list from the start of the file; a numeric value positions the list at that Tran ID; a non-numeric value is rejected.

rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM = 0, then PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD increments it.
rules.statement: Every Enter (and the first display) restarts paging: the page number is reset to 0 before the forward page read, so the first page shown is page 1.

messages: You are already at the top of the page...
rules.outcome: TRAN-ID = CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST, NEXT-PAGE-YES, PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD; else message 'You are already at the top of the page...' sent without erase.
rules.statement: PF7 (previous page) is allowed only when the current page number is greater than 1; the backward browse starts at the first Tran ID of the current page (or LOW-VALUES if none is stored). On page 1 the user is told they are already at the top.

messages: You are already at the bottom of the page...
rules.outcome: TRAN-ID = CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST, PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD; else message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' sent without erase.
rules.statement: PF8 (next page) is allowed only when the previous forward read found a record beyond the 10 shown (next-page flag 'Y'); the browse starts at the last Tran ID of the current page (HIGH-VALUES if none is stored). Otherwise the user is told they are already at the bottom.

rules.anchor: IF EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF7 AND DFHPF3
rules.conditions: EIBAID not Enter, PF7 or PF3
rules.outcome: One READNEXT is issued and discarded before filling rows.
rules.statement: When paging forward with PF8 the record at the start key (the last Tran ID of the previous page) is skipped so it is not repeated; for Enter (filter or first display) the list starts with the record at the start key itself.

rules.anchor: PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX >= 11 OR TRANSACT-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
rules.conditions: WS-IDX < 11 and not end of file and no error
rules.outcome: Rows 1..n populated via POPULATE-TRAN-DATA; remaining rows blank.
rules.statement: A page holds at most 10 transactions: the 10 rows are cleared and then filled with up to 10 consecutive TRANSACT records in ascending Tran ID order, stopping early at end of file or on error.

rules.conditions: TRANSACT-NOT-EOF and no error after 10 rows; else WS-IDX > 1
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM + 1; NEXT-PAGE-YES if the 11th record exists, otherwise NEXT-PAGE-NO.
rules.statement: After a forward page fill, the page number is increased by 1 when the page is full and records remain, and a look-ahead read decides whether a next page exists; when end of file was reached during the fill, there is no next page and the page number is increased only if at least one row was shown.

rules.anchor: IF EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF8
rules.conditions: EIBAID not Enter or PF8 for the skip; WS-IDX > 0 and not end of file and no error for the fill
rules.outcome: Rows filled from WS-IDX 10 down to 1.
rules.statement: When paging backward with PF7 the record at the start key (the first Tran ID of the current page) is skipped, then up to 10 previous records are read in descending Tran ID order and placed from row 10 up to row 1 so the screen remains in ascending order.

rules.conditions: TRANSACT-NOT-EOF and no error after the fill, NEXT-PAGE-YES, look-ahead READPREV result, CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM > 1
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM - 1 or = 1.
rules.statement: After a full backward page, a further previous record is read: if it exists and the page number is above 1, the page number is decreased by 1; otherwise the page number is forced to 1. If the backward fill hit the start of the file, the page number is left unchanged.

rules.outcome: WS-TRAN-DATE and WS-TRAN-AMT moved to TDATEnnI / TAMTnnnI.
rules.statement: Each listed transaction shows its original timestamp date reformatted from YYYY-MM-DD to MM/DD/YY and its amount edited with sign and two decimals (+99999999.99).

rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST / CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST updated in the COMMAREA.
rules.statement: The Tran ID shown on row 1 is remembered as the page's first key and the Tran ID on row 10 as the page's last key; these keys are the start positions for PF7 and PF8 paging.

messages: You are at the top of the page...
rules.outcome: NOTFND: TRANSACT-EOF, 'You are at the top of the page...'. Other: DISPLAY RESP/REAS, WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.
rules.statement: Starting the browse: if no record exists at or after the start key the list is treated as at end and the user sees a top-of-page message; any other failure sets the error flag and shows a lookup-failure message, which stops the page fill.

rules.anchor: 'You have reached the bottom of the page...'
messages: You have reached the bottom of the page...
rules.outcome: ENDFILE: TRANSACT-EOF and message. Other: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y' and 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.
rules.statement: Reading forward: end of file stops the list with a bottom-of-page message; any other failure sets the error flag and shows a lookup-failure message.

rules.anchor: 'You have reached the top of the page...'
messages: You have reached the top of the page...
rules.outcome: ENDFILE: TRANSACT-EOF and message. Other: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y' and 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.
rules.statement: Reading backward: start of file stops the list with a top-of-page message; any other failure sets the error flag and shows a lookup-failure message.

rules.outcome: XCTL COSGN00C.
rules.statement: When started without a COMMAREA (EIBCALEN = 0) the user is sent to the sign-on program COSGN00C.

rules.conditions: NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED not SPACES/LOW-VALUES
rules.outcome: TRNIDINI = CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED; PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; screen sent.
rules.statement: On first entry, when a Tran ID was selected on the transaction list (CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED not blank), that transaction is looked up and displayed immediately without the user typing it; otherwise an empty view screen is shown.

rules.conditions: EIBAID value; for PF3 whether CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is blank
messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: DFHENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; DFHPF3 -> XCTL CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C; DFHPF4 -> CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN; DFHPF5 -> XCTL COTRN00C; other -> WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
rules.statement: On re-entry the attention key decides the action: Enter looks up the typed Tran ID; PF3 returns to the program that called this one (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM) or to the main menu COMEN01C when unknown; PF4 clears the screen; PF5 goes to the transaction list COTRN00C; any other key shows the invalid-key message.

messages: Tran ID can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', message shown, no file read.
rules.statement: A Tran ID is mandatory to view a transaction; no format (numeric) check is applied.

rules.outcome: NOTFND: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Transaction ID NOT found...'. Other: DISPLAY RESP/REAS, WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to lookup Transaction...'.
rules.statement: The transaction is read by exact Tran ID; if it does not exist the user is told it was not found, and any other read failure shows a lookup-failure message; in both cases the details are not displayed.

rules.anchor: MOVE WS-TRAN-AMT      TO TRNAMTI    OF COTRN1AI
rules.outcome: TRAN-RECORD fields moved to the COTRN1A detail fields and the screen sent.
rules.statement: A found transaction is displayed with its amount edited with sign and two decimals (+99999999.99); timestamps and other fields are shown as stored.

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: XCTL, clear, copy, process or invalid-key message
rules.statement: Without a commarea the program returns to sign-on COSGN00C. On re-entry ENTER processes the add request, PF3 returns to the calling program (or COMEN01C when none is recorded), PF4 clears the screen, PF5 copies the last transaction's data, and any other key shows 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

rules.anchor: MOVE CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED TO CARDNINI OF COTRN2AI
rules.conditions: First entry and CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED not spaces/low-values
rules.outcome: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY performed with the pre-filled card number
rules.statement: On first entry, if a selected value is present in CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED of the commarea, it is placed in the card number field and the add request is processed immediately (key lookup and validation).

rules.outcome: ADD-TRANSACTION or message with cursor on CONFIRM
rules.statement: A transaction is added only after explicit confirmation 'Y' or 'y'. 'N', 'n' or blank does not cancel but asks 'Confirm to add this transaction...'; any other value gives 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'. Confirmation is evaluated only after all key and data validations passed.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Account or Card Number must be entered...' TO WS-MESSAGE
messages: Account or Card Number must be entered...
Unable to lookup Acct in XREF AIX file...
Unable to lookup Card # in XREF file...
rules.outcome: Account and card fields populated from CARD-XREF-RECORD, or error message
rules.statement: The transaction must be tied to a card in the card cross-reference: if an account id is entered it must be numeric and exist in CXACAIX, and the cross-reference card number replaces the card field; otherwise a numeric card number must be entered and exist in CCXREF, and its account id is filled in. Account id takes precedence when both are entered; if neither is entered the request is rejected.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Type CD can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE
messages: Type CD can NOT be empty...
Category CD can NOT be empty...
Orig Date can NOT be empty...
Proc Date can NOT be empty...
Merchant ID can NOT be empty...
Merchant Name can NOT be empty...
Merchant City can NOT be empty...
Merchant Zip can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: Error message, cursor on field, task ends
rules.statement: All transaction data fields are mandatory and are checked in this order: type code, category code, source, description, amount, orig date, proc date, merchant id, merchant name, merchant city, merchant zip; the first empty field is reported ('<Field> can NOT be empty...').

rules.anchor: WHEN TTYPCDI OF COTRN2AI NOT NUMERIC
rules.outcome: 'Type CD must be Numeric...' / 'Category CD must be Numeric...'
rules.statement: Transaction type code and category code must be numeric.

rules.anchor: WHEN TRNAMTI OF COTRN2AI(1:1) NOT EQUAL '-' AND '+'
rules.conditions: Position 1 not sign, 2-9 not numeric, 10 not '.', 11-12 not numeric
rules.outcome: 'Amount should be in format -99999999.99'
rules.statement: The amount must be entered exactly as a sign ('+' or '-'), 8 digits, a decimal point and 2 digits (format -99999999.99); it is then converted with NUMVAL-C and redisplayed as +99999999.99.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD' TO WS-MESSAGE
rules.conditions: Any position of TORIGDTI/TPROCDTI violates the layout
messages: Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD
Proc Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD
rules.outcome: 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD' / 'Proc Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD'
rules.statement: Origination and processing dates must have the layout YYYY-MM-DD (4 digits, '-', 2 digits, '-', 2 digits).

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Proc Date - Not a valid date...'
messages: Orig Date - Not a valid date...
Proc Date - Not a valid date...
rules.outcome: 'Orig Date - Not a valid date...' / 'Proc Date - Not a valid date...'
rules.statement: Origination and processing dates must be valid calendar dates according to CSUTLDTC/CEEDAYS; a non-zero severity is rejected unless the CEEDAYS message number is 2513 (unsupported range), which is accepted.

rules.anchor: IF MIDI OF COTRN2AI IS NOT NUMERIC
rules.outcome: 'Merchant ID must be Numeric...'
rules.statement: Merchant id must be numeric.

rules.outcome: TRAN-ID = MAX(TRAN-ID) + 1
rules.statement: The new transaction id is the highest TRAN-ID currently in TRANSACT plus 1 (TRAN-ID treated as a 16-digit number); when the file is empty the first id is 1.

rules.anchor: MOVE TPROCDTI OF COTRN2AI TO TRAN-PROC-TS
rules.outcome: TRAN-RECORD populated; WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE
rules.statement: The new transaction record is built from the screen: type, category, source, description, amount (NUMVAL-C of the entered amount), card number (from the cross-reference lookup), merchant id/name/city/zip, and the 10-character orig/proc dates stored in the 26-character TRAN-ORIG-TS/TRAN-PROC-TS fields.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Tran ID already exist...' TO WS-MESSAGE
rules.outcome: Success or error message
rules.statement: Writing the transaction: success clears the screen and shows 'Transaction added successfully.  Your Tran ID is <id>.' in green; a duplicate key gives 'Tran ID already exist...'; any other error gives 'Unable to Add Transaction...'.

rules.anchor: MOVE TRAN-MERCHANT-ID TO MIDI OF COTRN2AI
rules.outcome: Screen data fields copied from last TRAN-RECORD; PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
rules.statement: PF5 pre-fills the data fields with those of the last transaction in TRANSACT (highest TRAN-ID, regardless of account or card) after validating the key fields, and then runs the normal add processing, which still requires confirmation.

rules.outcome: XCTL to COSGN00C
rules.statement: When returning to a previous screen with no target program set, the sign-on program COSGN00C is used.

rules.outcome: EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA.
rules.statement: PF3 returns to the calling transaction/program recorded in the commarea; if none is recorded (low-values, spaces or this program itself) it returns to the admin menu CA00 / COADM01C. A CICS SYNCPOINT is taken before the XCTL.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID-PFK10 AND (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED OR CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED) AND FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-NO AND FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-NO AND FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-NO
rules.outcome: Otherwise SET CCARD-AID-ENTER TO TRUE.
rules.statement: PF10 (confirm) is honoured only when a delete or update confirmation is pending and neither filter nor the selected row number has changed since the confirmation prompt; otherwise PF10 is processed as ENTER (re-validate and re-prompt). PF10 without a pending request is an invalid key and is also treated as ENTER.

rules.outcome: SEND TEXT WS-LONG-MSG and EXEC CICS RETURN (no TRANSID).
rules.statement: Before any list processing the program verifies DB2 connectivity with a priming query; if it fails, the formatted DB2 error is sent as plain text and the conversation ends.

rules.outcome: WS-RETURN-MSG to CCARD-ERROR-MSG; optional 8000-READ-FORWARD; 2000-SEND-MAP; COMMON-RETURN.
rules.statement: When any input edit fails, the screen is redisplayed with the error message; the current page is re-read from its first key only if neither filter is in error, so rows are not shown for an invalid or non-matching filter.

rules.outcome: 8000-READ-FORWARD or 8100-READ-BACKWARDS, INITIALIZE WS-EDIT-SELECT-FLAGS, 2000-SEND-MAP.
rules.statement: Paging: PF8 moves to the next page only when CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS, starting at WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE (the first row of the next page) and incrementing the page number; PF7 on page 1 re-reads the first page ('No previous pages to display'); PF7 on later pages decrements the page number and reads backwards from WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE. Row selections are cleared when paging.

messages: Delete HIGHLIGHTED row ? Press F10 to confirm
rules.outcome: ENTER: prompt 'Delete HIGHLIGHTED row ? Press F10 to confirm'. PF10: 9300-DELETE-RECORD; on success FLG-DELETED-YES, send map, then INITIALIZE commarea and set first page.
rules.statement: Deleting a transaction type is a two-step action: ENTER with a 'D' selection redisplays the page and asks for confirmation; PF10 with the 'D' selection performs the DELETE. After a successful delete the screen shows the result and the list state is reset so the next interaction starts from the first page.

messages: Update HIGHLIGHTED row. Press F10 to save
rules.outcome: ENTER: prompt 'Update HIGHLIGHTED row. Press F10 to save'. PF10: 9200-UPDATE-RECORD; on success FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED; 8000-READ-FORWARD; 2000-SEND-MAP.
rules.statement: Updating a transaction type description is a two-step action: ENTER with a 'U' selection validates the new description and asks for confirmation; PF10 performs the UPDATE and then re-reads and redisplays the current page.

rules.outcome: WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I) = LOW-VALUES, else FUNCTION TRIM(TRTYPDI(I)).
rules.statement: A row description entered as '*' or all spaces is treated as not supplied (LOW-VALUES); any other entry is trimmed of leading and trailing spaces before validation and update.

rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR, WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR(I) = '1', FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-YES.
rules.statement: The only valid row action codes are 'D' (delete) and 'U' (update); blank means no action. Any other code marks the row in error and rejects the input with 'Action code selected is invalid'. A 'U' row triggers the description edit.

rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR with message 'Please select only 1 action'.
rules.statement: Only one row action may be requested per screen: if more than one select field is non-blank, the input is rejected with 'Please select only 1 action' and the selected rows are flagged in error.

rules.outcome: WS-EDIT-SELECT-FLAGS initialised; exit 1210-EDIT-ARRAY.
rules.statement: Intended rule: if either filter was changed, all row selections are discarded and no row action is processed. As coded the change flags are evaluated before the filter edits set them, so this reset does not take effect (see observation).

rules.conditions: UPPER(TRIM(WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I))) = UPPER(TRIM(WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(I))) and equal trimmed lengths
messages: No change detected with respect to database values.
rules.outcome: WS-RETURN-MSG = 'No change detected with respect to database values.'; INPUT-ERROR is not set.
rules.statement: An update whose new description equals the current database description, ignoring case and leading/trailing spaces, is reported as 'No change detected with respect to database values.' and the description is not re-validated.

rules.anchor: ' can have numbers or alphabets only.'
rules.conditions: Description empty, or contains a character outside LIT-UPPER, LIT-LOWER, LIT-NUMBERS and space
messages: can have numbers or alphabets only.
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR; FLG-ALPHNANUM-BLANK or FLG-ALPHNANUM-NOT-OK; message only if no earlier message.
rules.statement: A changed transaction type description is mandatory and may contain only letters (A-Z, a-z), digits and spaces; otherwise the input is rejected with 'Transaction Desc must be supplied.' or 'Transaction Desc can have numbers or alphabets only.' and the description is highlighted.

rules.conditions: WS-IN-TYPE-CD not LOW-VALUES/SPACES/ZEROS and NOT NUMERIC
messages: TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR, FLG-TYPEFILTER-NOT-OK, FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES; else WS-TYPE-CD-FILTER = WS-IN-TYPE-CD with FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID.
rules.statement: The transaction type code filter is optional (blank, spaces or '00' mean no filter); if supplied it must be numeric (2 digits), otherwise the input is rejected with 'TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER' and row selection is disabled.

rules.conditions: WS-IN-TYPE-CD <> WS-CA-TYPE-CD (unless both empty); WS-IN-TYPE-DESC <> WS-CA-TYPE-DESC (unless both empty)
rules.outcome: INITIALIZE WS-CA-PAGING-VARIABLES; FLG-TYPEFILTER-CHANGED-YES / FLG-DESCFILTER-CHANGED-YES.
rules.statement: Changing either search filter (type code or description) restarts paging: the saved paging state (first/last keys, page number, next-page indicator) is cleared and the new filter value is remembered in the commarea.

rules.outcome: FLG-DESCFILTER-ISVALID; WS-TYPE-DESC-FILTER = '%' || TRIM(input) || '%'.
rules.statement: A non-blank description filter is applied as a 'contains' search: TR_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%<trimmed filter>%'. Inferred: the match is case-sensitive because the column is compared as stored without case folding.

rules.anchor: 'No Records found for these filter conditions'
messages: No Records found for these filter conditions
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR, filter flags NOT-OK, FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES.
rules.statement: When a type or description filter is supplied, the program counts matching TRANSACTION_TYPE rows first; if none match, the input is rejected with 'No Records found for these filter conditions', the supplied filters are flagged in error and row selection is disabled. A SQL error on the count is also treated as an input error with a formatted DB2 message.

rules.conditions: C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD: TR_TYPE >= WS-START-KEY, optional TR_TYPE = filter, optional TR_DESCRIPTION LIKE filter, ORDER BY TR_TYPE
messages: No records found for this search condition.
No more pages for these search conditions
rules.outcome: WS-CA-ROW-*-OUT(1..7), WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE, WS-CA-LAST-TR-CODE, CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS/NOT-EXISTS.
rules.statement: The list shows at most 7 transaction types per page in ascending TR_TYPE order starting at the page start key and honouring the active filters. An eighth row is fetched only to decide whether a next page exists and to set the next page's start key. If page 1 has no rows the message 'No records found for this search condition.' is shown; pressing PF8 at the end shows 'No more pages for these search conditions'. Other SQL errors stop the read with a formatted DB2 message.

rules.conditions: C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD: TR_TYPE < WS-START-KEY with the same filters, ORDER BY TR_TYPE DESC
rules.outcome: Rows filled from 7 to 1; WS-CA-FIRST-TR-CODE updated; on error WS-DB2-ERROR with 'Error on fetch Cursor C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD'.
rules.statement: Page back reads the 7 transaction types immediately before the current page's first code (TR_TYPE < start key, descending) and places them in rows 7 down to 1, so the page is shown in ascending order; the new first code becomes the start key. Any fetch that does not return a row is treated as a DB2 error.

rules.conditions: DELETE-REQUESTED-ON(I) / UPDATE-REQUESTED-ON(I) AND WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION AND FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO
rules.outcome: CA-DELETE-REQUESTED / CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED set, or SELECT-BLANK(I) when FLG-DELETED-YES / FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED.
rules.statement: A confirmation is armed (CA-DELETE-REQUESTED or CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED stored in the commarea) only when exactly one valid action is selected and no row has an invalid action; after a completed delete or update the row's select code is cleared.

rules.conditions: FLG-DELETED-YES, FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED, filter flags, AID key, CA-FIRST-PAGE, CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS, CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN
messages: HIGHLIGHTED row deleted.Hit Enter to continue
Type U to update, D to delete any record
rules.outcome: WS-INFO-MSG / WS-RETURN-MSG set; CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN set on first PF8 at the end.
rules.statement: Screen messages follow a fixed priority: delete success, update success, filter errors (no info message), confirmation prompts for a single delete/update on ENTER (only if filters unchanged), 'No previous pages to display' on PF7 at page 1, 'No more pages to display' on PF8 once the last page has already been shown, otherwise the hint 'Type U to update, D to delete any record'.

rules.conditions: UPDATE CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE SET TR_DESCRIPTION = :DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION WHERE TR_TYPE = :DCL-TR-TYPE
messages: Record not found. Deleted by others ?
rules.outcome: 0: SYNCPOINT, CA-UPDATE-SUCCEEDED, 'HIGHLIGHTED row was updated'; else CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED and formatted DB2 message.
rules.statement: A confirmed description update is committed (CICS SYNCPOINT) only on SQLCODE 0. Row not found (+100, 'Record not found. Deleted by others ? '), deadlock/timeout (-911, 'Deadlock. Someone else updating ?', also an input error) and other negative SQLCODEs ('Update failed with') keep the update request pending so the user can retry.

messages: Please delete associated child records first:
rules.outcome: 0: SYNCPOINT, CA-DELETE-SUCCEEDED, 'HIGHLIGHTED row deleted.Hit Enter to continue'; -532: CA-DELETE-REQUESTED + message; other: message.
rules.statement: A transaction type that still has category rows cannot be deleted: SQLCODE -532 (delete restricted by the TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY foreign key ON DELETE RESTRICT) produces 'Please delete associated child records first:' and keeps the delete pending. A successful delete is committed with CICS SYNCPOINT; any other SQLCODE produces 'Delete failed with message:'.

rules.conditions: PF12 with TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS/CREATE-NEW-RECORD/DETAILS-NOT-FOUND, or state C, L, F, 7, 6, or B with empty old details
messages: Enter transaction type to be maintained
rules.outcome: CDEMO-PGM-ENTER and TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED; empty search screen sent.
rules.statement: After a completed or failed save, a completed or failed delete, a cancelled new-record entry (backed out with no fetched record), or PF12 while viewing details, creating a record or on a not-found key, the screen restarts as a fresh search (enter transaction type).

rules.outcome: EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA).
rules.statement: PF3 returns to the calling transaction/program from the commarea, or to the admin menu CA00 / COADM01C when none is recorded, after a CICS SYNCPOINT.

rules.outcome: PFK-VALID, or PFK-INVALID with 'Invalid key pressed' and screen resent.
rules.statement: Function keys are only accepted in the screen states where they make sense: PF3 always; ENTER except while a delete confirmation is pending; PF4 when a record is shown or delete confirmation is pending; PF5 when changes are validated, the key was not found, or a delete is in progress; PF12 when validated, showing details, not found, confirming delete or creating new. Any other key redisplays the screen with 'Invalid key pressed'.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID-PFK04 AND TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS, then CCARD-AID-PFK04 AND TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE
messages: Delete this record ? Press F4 to confirm
rules.outcome: TTUP-CONFIRM-DELETE; then TTUP-START-DELETE and 9800-DELETE-PROCESSING.
rules.statement: Deleting a transaction type is two-step: PF4 on a displayed record asks 'Delete this record ? Press F4 to confirm'; a second PF4 in that state performs the DELETE.

rules.conditions: CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND; later CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED
messages: Press F05 to add. F12 to cancel
rules.outcome: TTUP-CREATE-NEW-RECORD; then 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING.
rules.statement: When the entered transaction type code does not exist, the user may press PF5 to create it: the screen switches to new-record entry ('Enter new transaction type details.'); after the description passes validation, PF5 saves it.

rules.outcome: TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED or TTUP-CHANGES-BACKED-OUT (then TTUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK).
rules.statement: PF12 cancels a pending action: cancelling a delete confirmation gives 'Delete was cancelled' and returns to the search prompt; cancelling validated changes gives 'Update was cancelled', restores the fetched values (backed out) and the next interaction returns to edit mode.

rules.outcome: TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE / TTUP-NEW-TTYP-TYPE-DESC = LOW-VALUES, else FUNCTION TRIM(input).
rules.statement: Screen input of '*' or all spaces in the type code or description is treated as not supplied (LOW-VALUES); other input is trimmed. When a not-found key is resent unchanged without PF5, the previously entered values are kept.

rules.outcome: FLG-TRANFILTER-ISVALID; TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED unless PF5.
rules.statement: If the key was not found and the user resends the same key: with PF5 the key is accepted for creation; otherwise the record is looked up again. Edits are skipped in both cases.

rules.outcome: TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED (and TTUP-INVALID-SEARCH-KEYS when invalid).
rules.statement: A transaction type code must be entered to search: blank input gives 'No input received' and stays on the search prompt; a code failing the numeric edit marks the search key invalid. The key edit is skipped in create-new and validated states.

rules.outcome: 9000-READ-TRANTYPE; TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS or TTUP-DETAILS-NOT-FOUND.
rules.statement: A valid search key is looked up in TRANSACTION_TYPE: if found the record is displayed for change or delete, otherwise the user is offered to add it.

rules.conditions: TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS AND NOT (INPUT-ERROR OR NO-CHANGES-DETECTED OR WS-INVALID-KEY)
rules.outcome: TTUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED.
rules.statement: When a displayed record has been changed and passes all edits, the program asks for confirmation ('Changes validated.Press F5 to save') instead of saving immediately; edit errors or no detected change keep the record in edit mode.

rules.outcome: TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS; CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM = 0; CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS = LOW-VALUES.
rules.statement: After a successful save the record is shown again; if the program was not entered from another transaction, the account context in the commarea (account id, card number, account status) is cleared.

rules.conditions: WHEN OTHER in 2000-DECIDE-ACTION (or any CICS abend via HANDLE ABEND)
rules.outcome: ABEND-ROUTINE: EXEC CICS SEND ABEND-DATA, HANDLE ABEND CANCEL, EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999').
rules.statement: Any screen state not handled by the decision logic is treated as a program error: the task sends the abend data ('UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO') to the terminal and abends with code 9999.

messages: No record found for this key in database
rules.outcome: INPUT-ERROR, FLG-TRANFILTER-NOT-OK, message.
rules.statement: A transaction type code that does not exist in TRANSACTION_TYPE is reported as 'No record found for this key in database'; a SQL error on the lookup is reported with the SQLCODE and SQLERRM. Both mark the key as not OK.

messages: Could not lock record for update
rules.outcome: SYNCPOINT on success; INPUT-ERROR on -911; error message otherwise.
rules.statement: Saving is an upsert: the description is UPDATEd by TR_TYPE; if no row exists (+100) the row is INSERTed. A successful update or insert is committed with CICS SYNCPOINT. Deadlock/timeout (-911) gives 'Could not lock record for update'; other negative SQLCODEs give 'Error updating: TRANSACTION_TYPE Table. SQLCODE:...' and insert failures 'Error inserting record into: TRANSACTION_TYPE Table. SQLCODE:...'.

rules.outcome: TTUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR, -BUT-FAILED, TTUP-SHOW-DETAILS or TTUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE.
rules.statement: The outcome of a save sets the next screen state: lock failure shows 'Changes unsuccessful' (lock error), a flagged update failure shows 'Changes unsuccessful' (failed), a concurrent-change condition returns to show details, and anything else is treated as committed ('Changes committed to database'). Inferred: because the failure flag is overwritten by the SQL error text, SQL failures also reach the committed state (see observation).

rules.conditions: DELETE FROM CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE WHERE TR_TYPE = TTUP-OLD-TTYP-TYPE
messages: Please delete associated child records first:
rules.outcome: 0: TTUP-DELETE-DONE + SYNCPOINT; -532: RECORD-DELETE-FAILED + message; other: TTUP-DELETE-FAILED + message.
rules.statement: A confirmed delete removes the transaction type by its fetched code and commits (CICS SYNCPOINT, 'Delete successful.'). If category rows still reference it (SQLCODE -532, foreign key ON DELETE RESTRICT) the message 'Please delete associated child records first:' with SQLCODE and SQLERRM is shown; any other failure sets delete-failed with 'Delete failed with message:'.

rules.outcome: XCTL COSGN00C.
rules.statement: When started without a COMMAREA (EIBCALEN = 0) the user is sent to the sign-on program COSGN00C.

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: DFHENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; DFHPF3 -> XCTL COADM01C; DFHPF7/DFHPF8 -> paging; other -> WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
rules.statement: On re-entry the attention key decides the action: Enter processes selection/filter, PF3 returns to the admin menu COADM01C, PF7 pages backward, PF8 pages forward; other keys are rejected with the invalid-key message.

rules.anchor: WHEN SEL0001I OF COUSR0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES
rules.conditions: SELnnnnI not SPACES/LOW-VALUES, first match in row order
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG / CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED set, otherwise SPACES.
rules.statement: Only one row selection is honoured per Enter: selection fields are tested from row 1 to row 10 and the first non-blank one is taken with the user ID of the same row; if none is filled the stored selection is cleared.

rules.anchor: 'Invalid selection. Valid values are U and D'
rules.conditions: CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG and CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED both not blank
messages: Invalid selection. Valid values are U and D
rules.outcome: 'U'/'u': XCTL COUSR02C; 'D'/'d': XCTL COUSR03C (FROM tranid CU00, FROM program COUSR00C, context 0). Other: message shown, error flag not set.
rules.statement: Valid row actions are 'U' (update) and 'D' (delete), upper or lower case. 'U' transfers to COUSR02C and 'D' to COUSR03C with the selected user ID in the COMMAREA; any other code is rejected with a message and the list is refreshed.

rules.anchor: IF USRIDINI OF COUSR0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
rules.outcome: SEC-USR-ID = LOW-VALUES or USRIDINI; CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM = 0; PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.
rules.statement: The optional start user ID positions the list: blank lists from the beginning of USRSEC, otherwise the browse starts at the entered user ID (no format validation). Each Enter resets the page number to 0 before reading the first page.

messages: You are already at the top of the page...
rules.outcome: PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD, else 'You are already at the top of the page...'.
rules.statement: PF7 (previous page) is allowed only when the page number is greater than 1; the backward browse starts at the first user ID of the current page (LOW-VALUES if none). On page 1 the user is told they are already at the top.

messages: You are already at the bottom of the page...
rules.outcome: PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, else 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.
rules.statement: PF8 (next page) is allowed only when the last forward read found an 11th user (next-page flag 'Y'); the browse starts at the last user ID of the current page (HIGH-VALUES if none). Otherwise the user is told they are already at the bottom.

rules.anchor: PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX >= 11 OR USER-SEC-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
rules.conditions: EIBAID not Enter/PF7/PF3 for the skip; WS-IDX < 11, not EOF, no error for the fill
rules.outcome: Rows 1..n populated, remaining rows blank.
rules.statement: A page holds at most 10 users. On PF8 the record at the start key (last user of the previous page) is skipped; the rows are cleared and up to 10 users are read in ascending user ID order.

rules.conditions: USER-SEC-NOT-EOF and no error; else WS-IDX > 1
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM + 1; NEXT-PAGE-YES/NO.
rules.statement: After a forward fill, the page number is increased by 1 when the page is full and a look-ahead read decides whether a next page exists; when end of file was hit during the fill there is no next page and the page number is increased only if at least one row was shown.

rules.anchor: IF EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER  AND DFHPF8
rules.conditions: EIBAID not Enter/PF8 for the skip; WS-IDX > 0, not EOF, no error for the fill
rules.outcome: Rows filled from 10 down to 1.
rules.statement: On PF7 the record at the start key (first user of the current page) is skipped and up to 10 previous users are read in descending order into rows 10 down to 1, so the screen stays in ascending order.

rules.conditions: USER-SEC-NOT-EOF and no error after the fill, NEXT-PAGE-YES, look-ahead result, CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM > 1
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM - 1 or = 1.
rules.statement: After a full backward page, one more previous record is read: if it exists and the page number is above 1 the page number is decreased by 1, otherwise it is set to 1. If the fill hit the start of the file, the page number is left unchanged.

rules.outcome: CDEMO-CU00-USRID-FIRST / CDEMO-CU00-USRID-LAST updated.
rules.statement: The user ID on row 1 is remembered as the page's first key and the user ID on row 10 as its last key; these are the start positions for PF7 and PF8.

messages: You are at the top of the page...
rules.outcome: NOTFND: USER-SEC-EOF, 'You are at the top of the page...'. Other: DISPLAY RESP/REAS, WS-ERR-FLG 'Y'.
rules.statement: Starting the browse: no user at or after the start key is treated as end of list with a top-of-page message; any other failure sets the error flag with a lookup-failure message, stopping the page fill.

rules.anchor: 'You have reached the bottom of the page...'
messages: You have reached the bottom of the page...
rules.outcome: ENDFILE: USER-SEC-EOF and message. Other: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to lookup User...'.
rules.statement: Reading forward: end of file stops the list with a bottom-of-page message; other failures set the error flag with a lookup-failure message.

rules.anchor: 'You have reached the top of the page...'
messages: You have reached the top of the page...
rules.outcome: ENDFILE: USER-SEC-EOF and message. Other: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to lookup User...'.
rules.statement: Reading backward: start of file stops the list with a top-of-page message; other failures set the error flag with a lookup-failure message.

rules.outcome: XCTL COSGN00C.
rules.statement: When started without a COMMAREA (EIBCALEN = 0) the user is sent to the sign-on program COSGN00C.

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: DFHENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; DFHPF3 -> XCTL COADM01C; DFHPF4 -> CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN; other -> WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
rules.statement: On re-entry the attention key decides the action: Enter validates and adds the user, PF3 returns to the admin menu COADM01C, PF4 clears the screen, any other key shows the invalid-key message.

rules.anchor: WHEN FNAMEI OF COUSR1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
rules.conditions: FNAMEI, LNAMEI, USERIDI, PASSWDI, USRTYPEI = SPACES or LOW-VALUES
messages: First Name can NOT be empty...
Last Name can NOT be empty...
User ID can NOT be empty...
User Type can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', message for the first blank field, cursor on that field, screen sent; no write.
rules.statement: To add a user, first name, last name, user ID, password and user type are all mandatory. They are checked in that order and only the first missing field is reported; no format or value checks are applied (e.g. user type is not restricted to 'A' or 'U').

rules.anchor: MOVE PASSWDI  OF COUSR1AI TO SEC-USR-PWD
rules.outcome: SEC-USER-DATA populated and WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE performed.
rules.statement: A new user security record is built directly from the screen: user ID, first name, last name, password (stored as entered, in clear text) and user type.

rules.outcome: NORMAL: fields cleared, green 'User <id> has been added ...'. DUPKEY/DUPREC: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'User ID already exist...'. Other: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to Add User...'.
rules.statement: User IDs must be unique: the add is rejected when a record with the same user ID already exists in USRSEC. On success the screen is cleared and a confirmation naming the user is shown; any other write failure is reported as unable to add.

rules.outcome: XCTL COSGN00C.
rules.statement: When started without a COMMAREA (EIBCALEN = 0) the user is sent to the sign-on program COSGN00C.

rules.conditions: NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and CDEMO-CU02-USR-SELECTED not SPACES/LOW-VALUES
rules.outcome: USRIDINI = CDEMO-CU02-USR-SELECTED; PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; screen sent.
rules.statement: On first entry, when a user was selected on the user list (CDEMO-CU02-USR-SELECTED not blank), that user is fetched and displayed for editing immediately.

rules.conditions: EIBAID value; for PF3 whether CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is blank
messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: DFHENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; DFHPF3 -> UPDATE-USER-INFO then XCTL; DFHPF4 -> CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN; DFHPF5 -> UPDATE-USER-INFO; DFHPF12 -> XCTL COADM01C; other -> WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
rules.statement: Key actions on re-entry: Enter fetches the user; PF5 saves changes; PF3 also attempts to save changes and then returns to the calling program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, or COADM01C when unknown) regardless of the save outcome; PF4 clears the screen; PF12 returns to the admin menu COADM01C without saving; other keys show the invalid-key message.

rules.anchor: WHEN USRIDINI OF COUSR2AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
messages: User ID can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'User ID can NOT be empty...', no read.
rules.statement: A user ID is required to fetch a user for update.

rules.anchor: WHEN PASSWDI OF COUSR2AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
rules.conditions: USRIDINI, FNAMEI, LNAMEI, PASSWDI, USRTYPEI blank
messages: User ID can NOT be empty...
First Name can NOT be empty...
Last Name can NOT be empty...
User Type can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', message for the first blank field, screen sent; no update.
rules.statement: To save an update, user ID, first name, last name, password and user type must all be non-blank; they are checked in that order and only the first missing field is reported. No value or format checks are applied (user type is not restricted to 'A'/'U').

rules.anchor: IF FNAMEI  OF COUSR2AI NOT = SEC-USR-FNAME
rules.conditions: No validation error; screen value NOT = stored value per field
rules.outcome: SEC-USR-FNAME / SEC-USR-LNAME / SEC-USR-PWD / SEC-USR-TYPE updated, USR-MODIFIED-YES.
rules.statement: Only fields that differ from the stored record are changed: first name, last name, password and user type on the screen are each compared with the record just read, the new value is copied when different, and the record is marked as modified. The user ID itself is the key and cannot be changed.

rules.outcome: UPDATE-USER-SEC-FILE; else message 'Please modify to update ...' in red (DFHRED).
rules.statement: The user record is rewritten only when at least one field was changed; otherwise the user is asked to modify something and nothing is written.

messages: Press PF5 key to save your updates ...
rules.outcome: NORMAL: 'Press PF5 key to save your updates ...' (DFHNEUTR) and screen sent. NOTFND: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'User ID NOT found...'. Other: DISPLAY RESP/REAS, WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to lookup User...'.
rules.statement: Fetching the user by exact user ID: if found the user is prompted to press PF5 to save; if not found the user is told so; other failures report a lookup error. Not-found and lookup errors set the error flag.

rules.anchor: ' has been updated ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE
rules.outcome: NORMAL: green 'User <id> has been updated ...'. NOTFND: 'User ID NOT found...'. Other: 'Unable to Update User...'.
rules.statement: Saving the user: a successful rewrite shows a green confirmation naming the user; not-found and other failures set the error flag with their messages.

rules.outcome: XCTL COSGN00C.
rules.statement: When started without a COMMAREA (EIBCALEN = 0) the user is sent to the sign-on program COSGN00C.

rules.conditions: NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and CDEMO-CU03-USR-SELECTED not SPACES/LOW-VALUES
rules.outcome: USRIDINI = CDEMO-CU03-USR-SELECTED; PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; screen sent.
rules.statement: On first entry, when a user was selected for deletion on the user list (CDEMO-CU03-USR-SELECTED not blank), that user is fetched and displayed immediately with the delete prompt.

rules.conditions: EIBAID value; for PF3 whether CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is blank
messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: DFHENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; DFHPF3 -> XCTL CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM or COADM01C; DFHPF4 -> clear; DFHPF5 -> DELETE-USER-INFO; DFHPF12 -> XCTL COADM01C; other -> WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY.
rules.statement: Key actions on re-entry: Enter fetches the user; PF5 deletes the user whose ID is on the screen; PF3 returns to the calling program (CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, or COADM01C when unknown); PF4 clears the screen; PF12 returns to the admin menu COADM01C; other keys show the invalid-key message.

rules.anchor: WHEN USRIDINI OF COUSR3AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
messages: User ID can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'User ID can NOT be empty...', no read.
rules.statement: A user ID is required to look up a user for deletion.

messages: User ID can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: READ UPDATE then DELETE of SEC-USR-ID; blank ID gives 'User ID can NOT be empty...'.
rules.statement: PF5 deletes the user whose ID is currently in the input field; the only condition is that the ID is not blank. The user does not have to have been displayed first (no confirmation state is kept).

rules.anchor: 'Press PF5 key to delete this user ...'
messages: Press PF5 key to delete this user ...
rules.outcome: NORMAL: prompt (DFHNEUTR) and screen sent. NOTFND: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'User ID NOT found...'. Other: DISPLAY RESP/REAS, WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to lookup User...'.
rules.statement: Fetching the user by exact user ID: if found the user is prompted to press PF5 to delete; if not found the user is told so; other failures report a lookup error. Not-found and lookup errors set the error flag.

rules.anchor: ' has been deleted ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE
rules.outcome: NORMAL: fields cleared, green 'User <id> has been deleted ...'. NOTFND: 'User ID NOT found...'. Other: DISPLAY RESP/REAS, 'Unable to Update User...'.
rules.statement: Deleting the user: success clears the screen and shows a green confirmation naming the user; not-found and other failures set the error flag with their messages (the generic failure text says 'Update').

rules.anchor: CALL "CEEDAYS" USING WS-DATE-TO-TEST, WS-DATE-FORMAT, OUTPUT-LILLIAN, FEEDBACK-CODE
rules.outcome: WS-SEVERITY-N and WS-MSG-NO-N set from FEEDBACK-CODE
rules.statement: A date is valid when the Language Environment service CEEDAYS can convert the supplied date string using the supplied format mask into a Lilian day number; the validity is expressed by the CEEDAYS feedback severity and message number.

rules.anchor: WHEN FC-UNSUPP-RANGE MOVE 'Unsupp. Range ' TO WS-RESULT
rules.outcome: WS-RESULT text
rules.statement: The CEEDAYS feedback token is translated into a short result text: all-zero token -> 'Date is valid'; message 2507 -> 'Insufficient'; 2508 -> 'Datevalue error'; 2509 -> 'Invalid Era'; 2513 -> 'Unsupp. Range'; 2517 -> 'Invalid month'; 2518 -> 'Bad Pic String'; 2520 -> 'Nonnumeric data'; 2521 -> 'YearInEra is 0'; any other token -> 'Date is invalid'.

rules.outcome: LS-RESULT filled; RETURN-CODE = severity
rules.statement: The validation outcome is returned to the caller as an 80-byte result (severity in bytes 1-4, 'Mesg Code:', message number in bytes 16-19, result text, tested date and mask) and the CEEDAYS severity is also placed in RETURN-CODE; the subprogram never abends on an invalid date, leaving the decision to the caller.

rules.outcome: ISRT to PASFLPCB, then details ISRT to PADFLPCB.
rules.statement: Only pending authorization summaries whose account id (PA-ACCT-ID) is numeric are unloaded; for those, the summary and all its child details are written to the GSAM datasets. Summaries with a non-numeric account id and their details are skipped silently.

rules.anchor: IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'GB'
rules.outcome: DISPLAY diagnostics, RETURN-CODE 16, GOBACK.
rules.statement: The unload stops with return code 16 on any IMS status other than blank or 'GB' on the summary read, other than blank or 'GE' on the detail read, or any non-blank status on a GSAM insert.

rules.conditions: ROOT-SEG-KEY IS NUMERIC and GU on PAUTSUM0 (ACCNTID EQ key) returns blank status
rules.outcome: ISRT PAUTDTL1 under that root.
rules.statement: A detail record from the child file is loaded only when its packed account key (ROOT-SEG-KEY) is numeric; it is inserted as a PAUTDTL1 child under the PAUTSUM0 root whose ACCNTID equals that key. Records with a non-numeric key are skipped silently.

rules.anchor: IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'II'
rules.outcome: 'II' -> message only; other non-blank -> RETURN-CODE 16.
rules.statement: Reloading is re-runnable: a root or child segment that already exists (IMS status 'II') is reported and skipped rather than treated as an error; any other insert failure ends the run with return code 16.

rules.outcome: 9999-ABEND (RETURN-CODE 16).
rules.statement: An input file that cannot be opened ends the run with return code 16; read errors other than end of file are only displayed and processing continues.

rules.outcome: WRITE OPFIL1-REC; WRITE OPFIL2-REC per detail with ROOT-SEG-KEY = PA-ACCT-ID.
rules.statement: Only pending authorization summaries with a numeric account id are unloaded; for each such summary the summary record is written to OUTFIL1 and each child detail is written to OUTFIL2 prefixed with the packed account id so it can be re-parented on reload.

rules.anchor: IF PAUT-PCB-STATUS NOT EQUAL TO  SPACES AND 'GB'
rules.conditions: Open status not spaces/'00'; unexpected PCB status
rules.outcome: DISPLAY, RETURN-CODE 16, GOBACK.
rules.statement: The unload stops with return code 16 when an output file cannot be opened or when IMS returns an unexpected status (not blank/'GB' on summary, not blank/'GE' on detail).
